La autoridad indicó, además, que no reaccionará de forma mecánica a las decisiones de la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] estadounidense, que elevó la semana pasada su tasa en 25 puntos básicos y proyectó al menos otro incremento antes de finalizar el año. * La moneda local se negociaba en 17.7448 por dólar en la recta final de los negocios, con una pérdida de un 1.3%, aunque poco antes llegó a depreciarse hasta 17.7710 unidades, su nivel más débil desde inicios de abril. * El declive estuvo acompañado por un fortalecimiento global de la [USN:L1N45G0Z4 TEXT:"divisa estadounidense"] que tocó máximos de dos meses, mientras que los [USN:L6N45G14L TEXT:"precios del petróleo"] subieron, después de que un ataque con misiles de los hutíes contra Arabia Saudita reavivó el temor a una interrupción del suministro mundial. * A nivel doméstico, el mensaje de Banxico reforzó la expectativa de que mantendrá la tasa clave sin cambios durante un periodo prolongado. Un [USN:L6N45D0SW TEXT:"sondeo de Reuters"] mostró el lunes que el mercado anticipa que el banco central mexicano la conservará estable al menos hasta la segunda mitad de 2028. * En cambio, una ola de comentarios recientes de funcionarios de la Fed, incluidos [USN:L6N45G0KQ TEXT:"John Williams"], [USN:L6N45G0UM TEXT:"Beth Hammack"] y [USN:L6N45G0XB TEXT:"Anna Paulson"] el jueves, afianzaron la perspectiva de que podrían requerirse más alzas de tasas en Estados Unidos para contener la inflación. * La atención de los inversionistas está puesta así en el diferencial de rendimientos entre México y Estados Unidos, un factor que por largo tiempo ha impulsado la entrada de flujos a los mercados locales desde el exterior. * En el frente externo, la sesión estuvo marcada por el comienzo de una cumbre entre el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, y a su par chino, [USN:L8N45G1N5 TEXT:"Xi Jinping"], en la Casa Blanca. * La bolsa, por su parte, recortó parte de sus pérdidas iniciales y cerró prácticamente estable. El índice líder S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) bajó un marginal 0.02% a 64,264.16 puntos, en línea con una jornada de vaivenes en [USN:L1N45G11H TEXT:"Wall Sreet"]. * Las acciones del operador bursátil Grupo BMV (BOLSAA.MX) fueron las que mostraron el peor desempeño, al caer un 2.19% a 38.05 pesos. Por el contrario, los títulos del grupo aeroportuario GAP (GAPB.MX) ganaron un 2.69% a 374.78 pesos. * En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años subió ocho puntos base a un 9.45%, mientras que la tasa a 20 años ascendió cinco, a un 9.85%.

item.title: 原油先物3％高、フーシ派のサウジ攻撃で供給不安が再燃
item.description:
Scott DiSavino
[ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Scott DiSavino

[ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、約３％上昇し１週間ぶりの高値を付けた。フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへのミサイル攻撃を受けて供給混乱への懸念が再燃した。

取引は不安定で、米国とイランがホルムズ海峡の再開について協議していると報じられたのを受け、価格は取引時間中の高値から後退した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．５２ドル（３．４％）高の１バレル＝１０６．６０ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．４５ドル（２．７％）高の９４．６１ドル。取引時間中の高値では、両限月ともに約５％上昇していた。

イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２４日、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドの「重要目標」と、紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにある国営石油会社サウジアラムコの施設をミサイルと無人機（ドローン）で攻撃したと表明した。

サウジ主導の連合はこの日、フーシ派が２４日に発射した弾道ミサイル６発を迎撃し、南部タイフと紅海沿岸のヤンブー地区への攻撃を阻止したと明らかにしていた。

item.title: Four takeaways from Trump's summit with Xi in Washington
item.description: US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday, with talks on trade and artificial intelligence and the growing strategic rivalry between the countries all in the spotlight during an elaborate state visit.
item.dc:creator: Simon Lewis, Trevor Hunnicutt, David Brunnstrom
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday, with talks on trade and artificial intelligence and the growing strategic rivalry between the countries all in the spotlight during an elaborate state visit. Here are some major takeaways from the talks: TRADE DEAL EXTENDED, FOR NOW US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the two sides had extended a trade truce that was due to expire in November during talks, but only by two months. He said the extension would give the two sides "more time to see what we can do on the economic front." But rather than locking in a durable agreement, the extension appears to push the central questions — tariffs, Chinese purchases, rare-earth supplies and technology restrictions — into the next round of negotiations. Bessent said on Wednesday that Beijing was meeting its requirement in the earlier agreement to buy 25 million tons of soybeans but was lagging on its pledge to buy $17 billion in other agricultural goods. US officials have said rare-earth deliveries were also falling short, another sign that significant gaps remain. For companies, the result is a familiar form of instability: tariff rates remain lower for now, but decisions must still be made against a shifting policy backdrop. Trump and Xi could have more opportunities to hammer out a more permanent deal ahead of the new January 10 deadline, with two multilateral summits scheduled in Shenzhen and Miami before the end of the year. XI WANTS US 'PRUDENCE' OVER TAIWAN As expected, Xi pressed Trump on the Taiwan issue, saying, according to China's official news agency Xinhua, that China hoped the United States would "handle the Taiwan question with prudence to lay a solid foundation for bilateral strategic cooperation and the development of China-US ties." The agency's English-language service also wrote that Xi hoped the US would oppose Taiwan independence. That would be a tougher version of Washington's long-standing formulation that it does not "support" independence. There are no signs that the Trump administration plans to change its wording. There was no immediate White House readout of the exchange, but US officials have long avoided explicitly stating opposition to Taiwanese independence. Any shift in language would raise questions about Washington's resolve to defend the island and provoke opposition in Congress. Washington is Taiwan's most important international backer and is bound by US law to provide it with the means to defend itself. Trump raised questions about that commitment after his summit with Xi in May when he described a pending arms package for Taiwan worth up to $14 billion as a "negotiating chip." STRATEGIC RISK Xi, not for the first time while meeting Trump, invoked the "Thucydides Trap", an academic theory that competition between a rising power and an established one tends toward war. While the Chinese leader said the risk "can be overcome," his reference underscored the extent to which concerns about a potential US-China military conflict continue to shadow relations between the world's two largest powers. Xi argued that both nations stand to gain from cooperation and lose from confrontation, and he called for regular military dialogue and stronger crisis-prevention mechanisms. Trump, for his part, drew on the two nations' shared history to emphasize the potential for cooperation. They could accomplish much by pursuing common interests, he said, invoking their wartime alliance against Japan. DRESS TO IMPRESS For Trump, Xi's White House visit was an opportunity to show off a Washington being remade in his image. After Xi treated Trump in Beijing to a tour around a Ming dynasty temple and a walled-off garden retreat rarely opened to foreigners, the US president returned the favor with a different kind of spectacle: Troops wearing wigs and tri-corner hats marched in formation and played music in a Rose Garden redesigned to look like a Trump golf club. Fighter jets and bombers roared overhead during ceremonies staged on Wednesday and Thursday, one so loud it caused Trump to flinch. Trump has talked for months about needing more authority, often [USN:L1N3YZ1G0 TEXT:"over the objection"] of courts and the US Congress, to beautify and remodel the nation’s capital ahead of Xi's visit, although many of the projects, like the new White House ballroom and the Reflecting Pool, are not yet finished or have run into problems. When the White House press corps was called to cover the two leaders, it wasn’t to hear them talk about the weighty affairs of state. Instead, it was to watch them tour the Marine One helicopter and the recently redesigned South Lawn of the White House, replete with a large helipad emblazoned with the presidential seal. Speaking to reporters, Trump brushed away questions about their policy discussions. “He loves good granite,” Trump said of Xi. “Great meeting.”

item.title: US law firm Duane Morris settles ex-partner's lawsuit over pay
item.description: US law firm Duane Morris has agreed to resolve a lawsuit that accused the firm of misclassifying some of its employees as partners in a bid to force them to pay part of the firm's taxes and expenses while denying them a share of its profits.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella, David Thomas
item.content:encoded: US law firm Duane Morris has agreed to resolve a lawsuit that accused the firm of misclassifying some of its employees as partners in a bid to force them to pay part of the firm's taxes and expenses while denying them a share of its profits. The firm and plaintiff Meagan Garland said in a filing in federal court in California on Wednesday that they reached an accord after mediation and were hashing out the terms. Duane Morris had no immediate comment, and a lawyer for Garland did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Garland, who was previously a partner in the firm's employment practice, filed the [USN:L1N3JO14Q TEXT:"proposed class action lawsuit"] against Duane Morris in August 2024. She alleged the Philadelphia-based firm was misclassifying its non-equity partners as "partners" even though they can be hired and fired at-will, and do not have an ownership stake in the firm. Many US law firms internally designate some partners as non-equity or "income" partners. Such partners typically earn far less than full equity partners, whose compensation is tied directly to firm profits. Several major law firms in recent years have [USN:L1N3LM0MX TEXT:"created non-equity partnership tiers"]. After promoting lower-ranked lawyers to its non-equity partner tier, Duane Morris ceases paying the employer's share of their federal and state payroll taxes, as well as their benefits such as health care, vision, dental and disability insurance, Garland alleged. Duane Morris in a court filing had denied any wrongdoing and said Garland was a "genuine partner whom the firm has always compensated and otherwise treated fairly and well within the bounds of the law." US District Judge Cathy Ann Bencivengo in San Diego last year [USN:L1N3TW0SY TEXT:"denied the law firm's bid"] to dismiss most of the claims in the lawsuit. The case is Meagan Garland v. Duane Morris, LLP, et al., US District Court for the Southern District of California, 3:24-cv-01783 For Meagan Garland: Bibianne Fell and Marlee Horwitz of Fell Law For Duane Morris: Anthony Oncidi, Gregory Knopp, Philippe Lebel and Elise Bloom of Proskauer Rose

item.title: Drug developer City Therapeutics files for US IPO as biotech listings surge
item.description: Drug developer City Therapeutics filed for a US initial public offering on Thursday, joining a rush of biotech firms lining up to tap the fall IPO window.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Drug developer City Therapeutics filed for a US initial public offering on Thursday, joining a rush of biotech firms lining up to tap the fall IPO window. Biotech has been one of the key themes of the IPO market this year amid renewed investor interest in the industry, although fall listings have struggled to gain momentum as surging bond yields, a tightening rate environment and concerns around the AI trade weigh on risk appetite. ADARx Pharmaceuticals, which is developing RNA-based drugs for rare diseases, is [USN:L4N45D0MS TEXT:"expected to go public"] in New York on Friday. Drug developers [USN:L4N45A1Q0 TEXT:"Retension Pharmaceuticals, TRex Bio"] and [USN:L4N45D1EI TEXT:"Iambic Therapeutics"] earlier this month also unveiled their US IPO filings, a key step ahead of a potential roadshow launch. Founded in 2023, City Therapeutics is advancing a pipeline of RNA-based drugs for rare diseases. Its most advanced product candidate, CITY-FXI, is in an early-stage trial to treat thrombosis, which is the formation of harmful clots inside a blood vessel. The Cambridge, Massachusetts-based company has raised roughly $238.8 million since inception from life sciences investors, including ARCH Venture Partners, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Invus, and Viking Global Investors. City Therapeutics plans to sell new shares in the IPO. Goldman Sachs, Jefferies, Stifel and Oppenheimer are the underwriters for the offering. The company will list on the Nasdaq under the symbol “CTY.”

item.title: US airlines oppose China's bid to add more flights
item.description: The head of industry group Airlines for America said Thursday that carriers oppose adding more Chinese direct flights to the United States even as China's president Xi Jinping raised the idea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The head of industry group Airlines for America said Thursday that carriers oppose adding more Chinese direct flights to the United States even as China's president Xi Jinping raised the idea. Chris Sununu, who heads the group representing American Airlines (AAL.O) , United Airlines (UAL.O) , Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) and others, said U.S. carriers continued to be hampered by the fact that Chinese carriers are allowed to overfly Russia on eight flights. He said he has been advocating to Trump administration officials not to give in. "It's not just a minor thing. It's a huge cost to the airlines to have to go around Russia," Sununu said in an interview.

item.title: 米政権、オープンＡＩとアンソロピックに英への新モデル共有保留を要請＝報道
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米ホワイトハウスが人工知能（ＡＩ）大手のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックに対し、米...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米政権、オープンＡＩとアンソロピックに英への新モデル共有保留を要請＝報道 5:41 配信

6月11日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米ホワイトハウスが人工知能（ＡＩ）大手のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックに対し、米当局による審査が完了するまで、英国の試験担当者らに新ＡＩモデルを共有しないよう求めていたことが分かった。米メディアのポリティコが２４日、米政府高官や関係筋の話として報じた。

報道によると、ホワイトハウスは、パートナー国とのＡＩモデルの共有に先立ち、米国のシステムの安全性を確認するための措置を講じたい考えという。

ＡＩが外部システムに侵入するなどの「暴走」事例が相次いで報告されているほか、アンソロピックの研究者２人が、ＡＩの急速な進歩によって近い将来に「人類滅亡」につながる可能性があると警告したことを受け、ＡＩの安全性を巡る議論が活発化している。

また、オーストラリア政府は２４日、オープンＡＩが開発したＡＩエージェントが今年６月、豪政府の医療データポータルに侵入し、ファイルに不正アクセスしていたと明らかにした。

item.title: Banco Mundial aprueba 200 millones de dólares de financiación adicional a Colombia para atender terremoto
item.description: El Banco Mundial anunció el jueves que aprobó 200 millones de dólares en financiación adicional a Colombia para atender la recuperación del terremoto del 10 de agosto, que dejó cientos de muertos y billones de pesos en daños.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Banco Mundial anunció el jueves que aprobó 200 millones de dólares en financiación adicional a Colombia para atender la recuperación del terremoto del 10 de agosto, que dejó cientos de muertos y billones de pesos en daños. La financiación se suma a los 200 millones de dólares ya desembolsados a Colombia por el banco multilateral de desarrollo el 14 de agosto, en el marco de un programa anterior que incluía fondos de ayuda para desastres. El ministro de Hacienda de Colombia, Miguel Gómez, celebró la aprobación de los nuevos fondos y señaló que ayudarían a las comunidades afectadas por el terremoto. "Esta financiación adicional del Banco Mundial demuestra confianza en Colombia y en la capacidad del gobierno para responder de manera responsable en momentos difíciles", dijo en un comunicado difundido por el Banco Mundial. Los fondos proporcionarán un rápido apoyo presupuestario para atender las necesidades de reconstrucción tras el terremoto, al tiempo que continúan fortaleciendo los marcos de gestión y financiación del riesgo de desastres en Colombia, aseguró el Banco. El Banco Mundial sigue trabajando en una Evaluación Global Rápida de Daños Posdesastre (GRADE, por sus siglas en inglés), que ayudará a Colombia a priorizar la ayuda y las labores de reconstrucción. El sismo de magnitud 7,4 del 10 de agosto derribó edificios de apartamentos y causó daños en viviendas, escuelas y hospitales en una amplia región del oeste de Colombia. La semana pasada, el Programa de las Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo estimó que el terremoto causó daños por valor de unos 14.000 millones de dólares, una cifra muy superior a la estimación preliminar del gobierno colombiano, de 9.500 millones de dólares. Las autoridades colombianas estiman que 331 personas murieron a causa del terremoto y más de 4.500 resultaron heridas.

item.title: Israel's Abu Farchi sent off after gun gesture celebration
item.description: Israel forward Saied Abu Farchi was sent off for celebrating his goal against Austria in their 3-1 UEFA Nations League defeat on Thursday by using the corner flag to simulate a gun.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israel forward Saied Abu Farchi was sent off for celebrating his goal against Austria in their 3-1 UEFA Nations League defeat on Thursday by using the corner flag to simulate a gun. Abu Farchi headed home in the 55th minute to bring Israel level after Austria had taken the lead through a Romano Schmid penalty before halftime at the Raiffeisen Arena in Linz. The 20-year-old ran to the corner flag, grabbed it and made a gun-firing gesture during his celebration. The referee had booked Abu Farchi four minutes earlier and showed him a second yellow card for the celebration, followed by a red, leaving Israel with 10 players. Austria regained the lead in the 90th minute through Phillipp Mwene, who netted following a cross from Paul Wanner. Sasa Kalajdzic added a third in stoppage time with a close-range finish.

item.title: Cerca de 60 navios passaram pelo Estreito de Ormuz na 4ª, diz autoridade norte-americana
item.description: Cerca de 60 embarcações comerciais atravessaram o Estreito de Ormuz na quarta-feira, transportando o maior volume diário de petróleo bruto desde o início de julho, apesar da guerra em curso entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã, informou uma autoridade norte-americana à Reuters sob condição de anonimato.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cerca de 60 embarcações comerciais atravessaram o Estreito de Ormuz na quarta-feira, transportando o maior volume diário de petróleo bruto desde o início de julho, apesar da guerra em curso entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã, informou uma autoridade norte-americana à Reuters sob condição de anonimato. Aproximadamente 40 desses navios se coordenaram com as Forças Armadas dos EUA para obter proteção, acrescentou a autoridade. Um total quase 22 milhões de barris de petróleo saiu do ponto de estrangulamento marítimo. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar de forma independente os números apresentados pela autoridade norte-americana. O Estreito de Ormuz tornou-se fundamental para os esforços de encerrar o conflito de quase sete meses entre os EUA e o Irã, com o Irã buscando alívio do bloqueio norte-americano que sufoca sua economia e Washington pressionando Teerã a interromper a interferência na navegação pela importante rota global de abastecimento de petróleo. Antes do início da guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã, em 28 de fevereiro, o estreito costumava receber cerca de 125 grandes navios comerciais por dia, incluindo petroleiros, navios de gás, graneleiros e embarcações porta-contêineres, representando cerca de 20% do abastecimento diário mundial de petróleo bruto e gás natural liquefeito. A Reuters informou nesta quinta-feira que negociadores dos EUA e do Irã em Nova York avaliam um caminho gradual para sair da guerra, que envolveria a reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz por parte de Teerã e a suspensão do bloqueio econômico ao Irã por parte de Washington, segundo fontes próximas às negociações.

item.title: Trump and Xi agreed to support each other in hosting APEC, G20 summits, Xinhua reports
item.description: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed during a meeting in Washington to support each other in hosting the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting and the G20 summit in 2026, Xinhua news agency reported on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed during a meeting in Washington to support each other in hosting the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting and the G20 summit in 2026, Xinhua news agency reported on Thursday. Xi and Trump also exchanged views on the Middle East, Ukraine and the Korean Peninsula during the meeting, Xinhua reported.

item.title: 仏、サウジ西部ヤンブー防衛に部隊派遣 フーシ派攻撃受け＝大統領
item.description: [パリ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２４日 ロイター] - マクロン仏大統領は２４日、エネルギー輸送の要衝であるサウジアラビア西部の紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーを防衛するため、軍部隊のほか、防空システムを派遣すると表明した。

ヤンブーはホルムズ海峡を経由しないサウジ産原油の主要な代替輸出ルートになっているが、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃の標的になっており、原油価格上昇の一因になっている。

マクロン氏は国内テレビのインタビューに対し「ヤンブーを防衛するために兵士、レーダーシステム、防衛システムなどをの軍資源を派遣する。紛争に関与するのではなく、防衛のために派遣する」と述べた。

フーシ派はこの日、サウジの首都リヤドの「重要目標」と、ヤンブーにある国営石油会社サウジアラムコの施設をミサイルと無人機（ドローン）で攻撃したと表明した。

item.title: Mother of man wounded by ICE in Texas describes video call moments after shooting
item.description: The last time Wilber Rafael Garces Perez's mother heard his voice was on Sunday afternoon, moments after he had been shot by a federal immigration agent in his car in Austin, Texas, she told Reuters in an interview on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Keren Torres, Julia Harte, Kristina Cooke
item.content:encoded: The last time Wilber Rafael Garces Perez's mother heard his voice was on Sunday afternoon, moments after he had been shot by a federal immigration agent in his car in Austin, Texas, she told Reuters in an interview on Wednesday. "They crashed into my car and shot me," Flor Perez recalled her son telling her over a video call as she tried to calm him down from her home in Venezuela. Then she saw an officer pulling her son out of the vehicle by his arm. Four days later, Garces Perez, 28, remains in detention with a bullet still in his back and his mother said she has not been able to speak with him. Federal immigration agents have shot at least 20 people since Republican President Donald Trump returned to office, [USN:L1N43J0KR TEXT:"7 fatally"], sparking protests across the US. Critics contend that Trump's push to [USN:L6N4510WH TEXT:"ramp up deportations"] has led to an [USN:L6N3YA11U TEXT:"increasing number of violent confrontations"], and accuse the administration of resisting accountability for the agents involved. The sequence of events leading up to Sunday's shooting remains unclear. Garces Perez, who is from Venezuela, said he was working as a food delivery driver on Sunday when his car was sideswiped by agents with Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). He said they did not identify themselves or turn on their emergency lights until after the collision. ICE has not offered its own version of events or explained why Garces Perez was shot while sitting in his car. Its parent agency, the Department of Homeland Security, said in a Tuesday statement that Garces Perez was the subject of a "targeted vehicle stop" and that "resisting officers and evading arrest is dangerous for our officers, illegal aliens, and the public." Videos of the incident do not show the shooting, but do show Garces Perez injured in the car. The federal officer who shot him was not wearing a body camera, according to a person familiar with the incident. The officer, who has not been identified, was hired by ICE last year and had formerly worked for US Customs and Border Protection, the person said. After the fatal shootings of two men six days apart during July traffic stops in Texas and Maine, US border czar Tom Homan said ICE agents would be [USN:L6N43L064 TEXT:"required to record vehicle stops"] with at least one body-worn camera. ICE's acting director [USN:L6N44505O TEXT:"vowed to equip each officer"] with a body-worn camera by the end of August. Asked for comment about the officer involved and the account of Garces Perez's mother, DHS sent an information sheet that did not address Reuters' questions. 'INTENSE PAIN' Speaking from her home in Barquisimeto in northwestern Venezuela, Flor Perez, 51, said she was sleepless worrying about her son, hoping he would be allowed to see a doctor to remove the bullet and relieve his pain. "What matters to me is that they take him to a hospital and treat him," she said. Garces Perez's wound is currently stuffed with gauze that fills with blood and has to be changed two or three times a day, causing him "intense pain," Democratic US Representative Greg Casar of Texas said at a press conference on Wednesday night, hours after visiting him at an ICE detention facility. "If you saw Wilber, just like if you saw anybody that had been shot three days ago, you would say this person needs a doctor, not a deportation or a detention center," said Casar. Video released by Austin police on Tuesday from a body camera worn by one of its officers who responded to the incident shows Garces Perez inside his car with two ICE agents standing nearby. Garces Perez tells them his shoulder hurts, whereupon he is told to exit the vehicle and placed in handcuffs. A police officer then uses shears to cut away his shirt, revealing a gunshot wound to his upper back. In its information sheet, DHS said ICE "does not and would not advise, nor be the authority on, a medical procedure" and said Garces Perez was "receiving medical care around the clock." Perez said her son entered the United States from Mexico in December 2023 using CBP One, an app used by former President Joe Biden's administration to allow migrants to lawfully cross the border by [USN:L1N354308 TEXT:"scheduling an appointment"] with CBP. DHS has said Garces Perez's work permit expired in 2025, making him eligible for deportation. Garces Perez's "dream" in the US was to earn money to support his 7-year-old son, who was born with cerebral palsy and requires costly treatment in Venezuela. The family has not yet told him about what happened to his father. “We’re going to have to tell the boy little by little," Perez said, "because he asks to talk to his dad every day." Garces Perez's attorneys have filed a legal petition asking that he be released from custody so he can participate in the investigation into the shooting and pursue legal status. His first hearing before a federal immigration judge in Texas is set for next Wednesday.

item.title: Tribunal suspende novas transferências da Braskem para Idesa
item.description: A Segunda Vara de Falências e Recuperações Judiciais de São Paulo concedeu nesta quinta-feira uma medida cautelar bloqueando temporariamente a empresa petroquímica Braskem de transferir novos fundos para sua unidade mexicana, Braskem Idesa, dentro de um pacote de financiamento de US$415 milhões e uma injeção de capital de US$71 milhões vinculada ao pedido de recuperação judicial da unidade, de acordo com um documento visto pela Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Luciana Magalhaes
item.content:encoded: A Segunda Vara de Falências e Recuperações Judiciais de São Paulo concedeu nesta quinta-feira uma medida cautelar bloqueando temporariamente a empresa petroquímica Braskem (BRKM3.SA) de transferir novos fundos para sua unidade mexicana, Braskem Idesa, dentro de um pacote de financiamento de US$415 milhões e uma injeção de capital de US$71 milhões vinculada ao pedido de recuperação judicial da unidade, de acordo com um documento visto pela Reuters. Nos termos da ordem, os desembolsos estão suspensos até novo aviso, sendo o descumprimento passível de multas e responsabilização dos administradores da empresa. A decisão judicial segue um pedido de credores, que alegam que a transferência de fundos reduziria o capital da empresa brasileira. A Braskem Idesa, uma joint venture entre a Braskem e o mexicano Grupo Idesa, entrou com pedido de recuperação judicial (Chapter 11) nos Estados Unidos em agosto, após chegar a um acordo com credores e acionistas para reestruturar mais de US$920 milhões em dívidas. A Braskem, que também entrou com pedido de recuperação extrajudicial no Brasil, recusou-se a comentar a decisão judicial.

item.title: 米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ５００横ばい、中東協議進展観測で持ち直す
item.description: ［２４日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種がほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。中東情勢の不透明感から原油価格と...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ５００横ばい、中東協議進展観測で持ち直す 5:25 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で15日撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

［２４日　ロイター］　 - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種がほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。中東情勢の不透明感から原油価格と米国債利回りが上昇する中、マイクロソフト が軟調な一方、 メタ・プラットフォームズが値上がりした。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合は取引時間中の安値から持ち直した。米国とイランがニューヨークで続けている協議で、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結への道筋が模索されているとロイターが報じたことが背景にある。

原油市場では北海ブレント先物が３％超上昇。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへのミサイル攻撃を受け、供給混乱への懸念が再燃した。

ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのシニア投資ディレクター、ビル・ノーシー氏は「現在われわれが一つの大きな材料に直面しているという見方を強めるものだ」とし、「原油とインフレ、それが金利に与える影響、さらに金利が資本市場全体に与える影響だ 」と述べた。

ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は２４日、インフレリスクを抑制するために、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が年末までに再び利上げを行う必要があるかもしれないと考えるのは「妥当」だと述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち８業種が下落し、素材や主要消費財の下げが目立った。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の主要銘柄はまちまちで、マイクロソフトが０．５％安、ブロードコムが１．３％安となる一方、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）は２．４％上昇した。

メタは４．５％高。同社は前日、新たなＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」 を利用するための小型端末「メタ・チャーム」を発表した。

オラクルは３．５％下落。ニューメキシコ州のデータセンター開発を手がけるブルー・アウル傘下企業に「不可抗力」を通知したと報じられたことが響いた。ブルー・アウルも下落した。

ＭＧＭリゾーツは１１％急落。富豪のバリー・ディラー氏率いる米メディアのピープルが買収計画を撤回したことが響いた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．９対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１６８億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１６７億株。

item.title: Costco beats quarterly sales estimates on resilient demand for essentials
item.description: Costco Wholesale beat quarterly revenue estimates on Thursday, as resilient demand for essential goods from shoppers feeling squeezed by high inflation drove foot traffic to its warehouses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Costco Wholesale (COST.O) beat quarterly revenue estimates on Thursday, as resilient demand for essential goods from shoppers feeling squeezed by high inflation drove foot traffic to its warehouses. The company posted revenue of $95.72 billion for the fourth quarter, above Wall Street estimates of $94.86 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Earnings for the quarter were lifted by a benefit of 15 cents per diluted share arising from tariff refunds under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, Costco said. The warehouse retailer, which keeps prices low by selling in bulk, has seen foot traffic rise as consumers trade down on essentials amid inflationary pressures. That has helped fuel growth in average basket size as shoppers consolidate their trips to the store, loading up on groceries and other essentials in bulk in a single visit rather than multiple runs for fewer items. Costco gas stations — which usually sell below market value, according to TD Cowen analyst Oliver Chen — have also pulled in price-sensitive customers as the Iran war sends fuel prices soaring. The company posted adjusted earnings of $6.6 per share for the quarter, above analysts' estimates of $6.53 per share, according to data compiled by LSEG.

item.title: World Bank approves further $200 million to help Colombia recover from earthquake
item.description: The World Bank Thursday said it has approved $200 million in additional funding to help Colombia respond to and recover from the August 10 earthquake that left hundreds dead.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The World Bank Thursday said it has approved $200 million in additional funding to help Colombia respond to and recover from the August 10 earthquake that left hundreds dead. Funds are additional to $200 million already disbursed Colombian finance minister says funding demonstrates the bank's confidence in Colombia and its government Funds will go to reconstruction needs, disaster risk management The United Nations Development Program last week estimated that the 7.4 magnitude earthquake caused around $14 billion in damage Colombian authorities have estimated 331 people were killed in the earthquake and over 4,500 injured

item.title: Oklahoma must allow taxpayer-funded religious charter school, judge rules
item.description: A federal judge in Oklahoma cleared the way on Thursday for a Jewish organization to establish the nation's first taxpayer-funded religious charter school in a case over religious rights in American education that could eventually reach the US Supreme Court.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A federal judge in Oklahoma cleared the way on Thursday for a Jewish organization to establish the nation's first taxpayer-funded religious charter school in a case over religious rights in American education that could eventually reach the US Supreme Court . US District Judge David Russell in Oklahoma City issued a preliminary injunction blocking the state from excluding the National Ben Gamla Jewish Charter School Foundation from Oklahoma's charter program. State law requires charter schools to be nonsectarian. Charter schools are considered public schools under Oklahoma law and draw taxpayer funds from the state government. The judge said the restriction expressly discriminates against otherwise eligible schools solely because of their religious character in violation of the US Constitution's First Amendment protection for the right to exercise one's religion freely without government interference, known as the "free exercise clause." "A long line of Supreme Court precedent supports plaintiffs' position," wrote Russell, an appointee of Republican former President Ronald Reagan. Another provision of the First Amendment, called the "establishment clause," restricts government officials from establishing or endorsing any particular religion or promoting religion over nonreligion. Set up as alternatives to traditional public schools, charter schools typically operate under private management and often feature small class sizes, innovative teaching styles or a particular academic focus. The judge blocked the Republican-led state from enforcing its state law. Several Oklahoma taxpayers and families intervened to defend the law after the Oklahoma Statewide Charter School Board, which had denied Ben Gamla's application, opted not to oppose a ruling against the nonsectarian mandate. Daniel Chen, a lawyer for Ben Gamla at the religious rights legal group Becket, said in a statement that the ruling will ensure it "now gets what it should have had from the start: a fair shot to serve Oklahoma families." "The Constitution doesn't permit the state to welcome every kind of charter school except a religious one," Chen said. Lawyers for the interveners at groups including Americans United for Separation of Church and State and the American Civil Liberties Union in a joint statement said the ruling marked "a dangerous sea change for our democracy." "We will continue to fight for all Oklahomans, who deserve public schools that are secular and open to all students," they said. The ruling came a year after [USN:S0N3RD07K TEXT:"the Supreme Court split 4-4"] on whether to overturn an Oklahoma Supreme Court ruling that had prevented two Catholic dioceses from establishing a taxpayer-funded charter school in the state. The court was unable to resolve the issue after conservative Justice Amy Coney Barrett recused herself from the case. In ruling in favor of Ben Gamla, Russell cited a [USN:LUN2QW019 TEXT:"2022 ruling"] that the Supreme Court delivered that further reduced the separation of church and state by siding with two Christian families who challenged a Maine tuition assistance program that excluded private religious schools. Russell said that, similar to Maine, Oklahoma had by law "created a generally available benefit: the opportunity to apply for and contract with a sponsor to establish a charter school." "But the state categorically excludes religious institutions from participating," the judge wrote.

item.title: Na ONU, Netanyahu defende Israel enquanto delegados abandonam salão em protesto
item.description: O primeiro-ministro Benjamin Netanyahu fez nesta quinta-feira na ONU uma defesa veemente das ações de Israel na região, buscando combater o crescente isolamento internacional às vésperas de eleições que ele poderia perder, enquanto dezenas de delegados abandonavam o salão.
item.dc:creator: Antoni Slodkowski, John Irish
item.content:encoded: O primeiro-ministro Benjamin Netanyahu fez nesta quinta-feira na ONU uma defesa veemente das ações de Israel na região, buscando combater o crescente isolamento internacional às vésperas de eleições que ele poderia perder, enquanto dezenas de delegados abandonavam o salão. Quando Netanyahu subiu à tribuna, autoridades abandonaram a sessão da Assembleia Geral em protesto, ao que ele respondeu, chamando-os de “covardes morais”. Seus apoiadores na galeria entoavam em hebraico: “O povo de Israel vive”. Netanyahu aproveitou seu discurso na ONU para rebater o prefeito de Nova York, Zohran Mamdani, por chamá-lo de criminoso de guerra; os líderes da Europa Ocidental, por, segundo ele, sucumbirem a “multidões antissemitas”; e para acusar tanto o Catar quanto a Turquia de espalhar mentiras sobre Israel. “Vocês tentaram me impedir de vir aqui. Vocês tentaram. Tentaram me silenciar. Bem, vocês não podem me silenciar. Não podem silenciar a verdade”, disse Netanyahu sobre Mamdani. Mamdani fez campanha eleitoral com a promessa de mandar prender Netanyahu por supostos crimes de guerra caso ele visitasse a maior cidade dos Estados Unidos, mas posteriormente afirmou ter concluído que não possuía autoridade legal para fazê-lo. Nesta semana, Mamdani descreveu Netanyahu como “o arquiteto de um genocídio horrível contra os palestinos”. Em sua primeira visita a Nova York desde que Mamdani assumiu o cargo em janeiro, Netanyahu disse: “Eis uma verdade simples: Israel não cometeu genocídio. Israel impediu o genocídio.” Ele acusou falsamente Mamdani de apoiar militantes do Hamas. “A todos aqueles que espalham essas mentiras sobre meu país e sobre nossos bravos soldados, estejam eles neste salão ou no gabinete do prefeito antissemita de Nova York, eu digo o seguinte: Que vergonha para vocês!”, disse Netanyahu. Em comunicado, Mamdani afirmou: “Como já fez inúmeras vezes, o primeiro-ministro Netanyahu usou seu discurso para repetir mentiras infundadas com o objetivo de encobrir seu genocídio contra os palestinos. No entanto, nenhuma mentira pode mudar o fato de que ele continua sendo alvo de um mandado de prisão do Tribunal Penal Internacional por crimes de guerra e crimes contra a humanidade.” FUTURO POLÍTICO DE NETANYAHU EM JOGO A menos de cinco semanas das eleições gerais, Netanyahu falou por cerca de 40 minutos no que se configurou como um discurso de campanha, transmitido ao vivo no horário nobre da noite pelos quatro principais canais de televisão israelenses. Antes de seu discurso, o governo de Netanyahu pagou para colocar 500 outdoors pró-Israel e anti-Irã, além de dezenas de caminhões exibindo mensagens de apoio a Israel por toda Manhattan, informou o gabinete de Netanyahu em um comunicado. Netanyahu, que vem perdendo força nas pesquisas de opinião, destacou o que chamou de luta de Israel em sete frentes. Netanyahu, o primeiro-ministro mais longevo de Israel, já havia transformado suas aparições na ONU em espetáculos visuais no passado, usando gráficos, diagramas e adereços para alertar sobre o programa nuclear do Irã, que Teerã afirma ser para fins civis. Nesta quinta-feira, ele ergueu um pager em referência a um ataque que paralisou membros do Hezbollah, grupo apoiado pelo Irã, no Líbano, e mostrou um receptor de internet via satélite Starlink, que, segundo ele, deixaria para a delegação iraniana. “Assim, quando inevitavelmente romperem, eles também poderão contar livremente sua história nas redes sociais”, disse ele, acrescentando que era apenas uma questão de tempo até que as autoridades iranianas fossem derrubadas pelo povo. PROTESTOS NAS RUAS DE NOVA YORK Várias centenas de manifestantes se reuniram perto da sede da ONU, com dezenas bloqueando o trânsito e entoando: “Parem de armar Israel, deixem Gaza viver” e “Parem de armar Israel, deixem o Irã viver”. A polícia os deteve. A campanha eleitoral em Israel está ocorrendo em meio a críticas crescentes à guerra do país contra Gaza. Netanyahu está fazendo uma breve visita aos EUA para seu discurso na ONU e, o que é incomum, sem uma reunião agendada com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, a quem elogiou durante seu discurso. “Continuaremos a defender nosso Estado. Continuaremos a vencer porque não temos outra escolha. Nesta batalha contra os bárbaros, não tivemos parceiro maior do que o presidente Trump. Agradeço a ele. Agradeço a ele por sua liderança ousada”, disse ele. ISOLAMENTO CADA VEZ MAIOR Israel vem enfrentando um isolamento diplomático cada vez mais profundo desde que iniciou sua guerra em Gaza, em resposta aos ataques liderados pelo Hamas contra Israel há quase três anos. Netanyahu não pode viajar para muitos países devido a um mandado de prisão do Tribunal Penal Internacional, emitido contra ele, seu então ministro da Defesa e o então comandante militar do Hamas em 2024. No início deste mês, aliados outrora inabaláveis – Reino Unido, França e Canadá – anunciaram sanções contra os assentamentos israelenses na Cisjordânia ocupada, o que suscitou uma reação moderada de Washington. “Os líderes desses países optaram por ceder às multidões antissemitas. Optaram pela fraqueza. Optaram pela política de apaziguamento”, afirmou Netanyahu. Ele minimizou o agravamento da violência na Cisjordânia ocupada por parte de colonos israelenses, descrevendo-a como “um punhado de jovens delinquentes, cerca de 150, que atiram pedras e derrubam oliveiras”. “Ocasionalmente... eles ateiam alguns incêndios. Não suporto isso. Não tolerarei o vigilantismo. Somos um país de leis.”

item.title: Video de perro en simulacro fue grabado en Chile en 2023, no en México en 2026
item.description: Un video de un perro en un ejercicio vial fue grabado en la ciudad chilena de Puerto Montt en 2023 y no tiene relación con el simulacro nacional de sismo realizado en México en septiembre de 2026, como dicen publicaciones en redes sociales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un video de un perro en un ejercicio vial fue grabado en la ciudad chilena de Puerto Montt en 2023 y no tiene relación con el simulacro nacional de sismo realizado en México en septiembre de 2026, como dicen publicaciones en redes sociales. Estos son los detalles clave: Algunos ejemplos dicen que el video se grabó durante el simulacro que el gobierno de México convocó el 19 de septiembre , en conmemoración de [USN:S0N2Z8000 TEXT:"sismos"] en años anteriores. La cuenta de X @AnimalParaiso publicó el video el 5 de octubre de 2023 y dijo que correspondía a un simulacro vial en Puerto Montt. @AnimalParaiso dijo el 24 de septiembre en WhatsApp que el video se grabó en esa ciudad en 2023, pero que no es de su autoría. Reuters no encontró al autor original. La Comisión Nacional de Seguridad de Tránsito de Chile (Conaset) compartió el video con la misma información. Esta versión no incluye el sonido de alarma que se escucha en los videos en línea. En un comunicado , la Universidad Santo Tomás de Puerto Montt compartió imágenes del simulacro que coinciden con el clip y dijo que realizó el ejercicio junto con Bomberos, Carabineros y el Servicio de Atención Médica de Urgencia. El edificio de la Delegación Presidencial Regional de Los Lagos es visible en el video. La Conaset y la universidad no respondieron inmediatamente a solicitudes de comentarios. Veredicto: Erróneamente etiquetado. El video fue filmado en Chile en 2023 y no tiene relación con el simulacro en México en septiembre de 2026. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: White Sox place RHP Luis Castillo (shoulder) on IL
item.description: The Chicago White Sox placed right-hander Luis Castillo on the 15-day injured list Thursday with a right shoulder impingement and recalled right-hander Tyler Davis from Triple-A Charlotte.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Chicago White Sox placed right-hander Luis Castillo on the 15-day injured list Thursday with a right shoulder impingement and recalled right-hander Tyler Davis from Triple-A Charlotte. Castillo, 33, gave up four runs on three hits and a walk in the ninth inning of the White Sox's 14-11 victory over the host Kansas City Royals on Tuesday. He is a combined 4-11 with a 5.85 ERA in 29 appearances (23 starts) for the Seattle Mariners and White Sox this season. Since joining Chicago at the trade deadline, Castillo is 1-2 with an 8.42 ERA in nine appearances, with his last three outings coming after he was moved to the bullpen. Davis, 27, went 2-3 with one save and a 3.52 ERA in 29 relief appearances for the White Sox earlier this season after making his major league debut on April 25. --Field Level Media

item.title: BOLSA EUA S&P 500 encerra com queda marginal, enquanto investidores se concentram na guerra entre EUA e Irã
item.description: O S&P 500 fechou com uma queda marginal nesta quinta-feira, com a Microsoft em baixa e a Meta em alta, enquanto a incerteza em relação ao Oriente Médio impulsionou os preços do petróleo e os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich, Johann Cherian
item.content:encoded: O S&P 500 fechou com uma queda marginal nesta quinta-feira, com a Microsoft em baixa e a Meta em alta, enquanto a incerteza em relação ao Oriente Médio impulsionou os preços do petróleo e os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro. O S&P 500 e o Nasdaq se recuperaram das mínimas do pregão depois que a Reuters noticiou que negociadores dos EUA e do Irã estavam explorando um caminho gradual para sair da guerra, que envolveria a reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz por Teerã e o fim do bloqueio econômico imposto por Washington ao Irã. Líderes dos EUA e do Irã trocaram farpas nesta semana na Assembleia Geral da ONU. Os preços do petróleo Brent subiram mais de 3%, para quase US$107 por barril, depois que um ataque com mísseis dos militantes houthis à Arábia Saudita reacendeu os temores de interrupções no abastecimento. “Isso apenas reforça a visão de que estamos lidando com um grande catalisador de mercado neste momento”, disse Bill Northey, diretor sênior de investimentos na U.S. Bank Wealth Management. “Na verdade, tudo gira em torno do petróleo e da inflação e do efeito sobre as taxas de juros, e depois do impacto em cascata dessas taxas nos mercados de capitais.” As gigantes da IA apresentaram resultados mistos: a Microsoft (MSFT.O) caiu 0,5% e a Broadcom (AVGO.O) perdeu 1,3%, enquanto a Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) subiu 2,4%. A Meta (META.O) saltou 4,5%, um dia depois que a empresa de mídia social revelou um pequeno dispositivo portátil para uso com seu assistente de IA recém-lançado. A Oracle (ORCL.N) caiu 3,5% após uma reportagem informar que a empresa enviou uma notificação de “força maior” a um data center no Novo México. As ações da Blue Owl (OWL.N) , desenvolvedora do projeto, também registraram forte queda. Os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro subiram, com o rendimento do título do Tesouro de 30 anos atingindo seu nível mais alto desde 2004. Rendimentos mais altos tornam os títulos do Tesouro, considerados um porto seguro, relativamente mais atraentes para os investidores do que ações com retornos incertos. O S&P 500 teve variação negativa de 0,02%, encerrando o pregão em 7.704,13 pontos. O Nasdaq oscilou 0,01% para cima, a 26.939,37 pontos, enquanto o Dow Jones Industrial Average recuou 0,31%, para 51.349,98 pontos. Oito dos 11 índices setoriais do S&P 500 caíram, liderados pelo setor de materiais (.SPLRCM) , com queda de 1,18%, seguido por uma perda de 0,96% no setor de bens de consumo básico (.SPLRCS) . O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, recebeu o presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, na Casa Branca para uma cúpula que deve ter forte caráter simbólico, mas pouca substância em relação a questões como IA, comércio, Taiwan e a guerra no Oriente Médio. Dados divulgados na quarta-feira, sugerindo uma forte atividade empresarial, levaram a um aumento nas expectativas de que o Federal Reserve elevará as taxas de juros novamente, após o aumento de 25 pontos-base na semana passada. Os operadores de mercado estão agora precificando uma chance de quase 70% de um aumento no próximo mês, de acordo com a ferramenta CME FedWatch. O presidente do Fed de Nova York, John Williams, que tem direito a voto no Comitê Federal de Mercado Aberto, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que é razoável supor que o banco central dos EUA possa precisar aumentar as taxas de juros novamente antes do final do ano. A MGM Resorts (MGM.N) despencou 11% depois que a People Inc (PPLI.O) , do magnata da mídia Barry Diller, retirou sua proposta de compra da operadora de cassinos.

item.title: ATP roundup: Adolfo Daniel Vallejo hangs on to win at Hangzhou
item.description: No. 5 seed Adolfo Daniel Vallejo of Paraguay had seven aces and saved all four break points he faced while holding on for a 6-1, 6-7 (2), 6-4 victory over China's Jie Cui to win his first-round match of the Hangzhou Open on Thursday in China.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: No. 5 seed Adolfo Daniel Vallejo of Paraguay had seven aces and saved all four break points he faced while holding on for a 6-1, 6-7 (2), 6-4 victory over China's Jie Cui to win his first-round match of the Hangzhou Open on Thursday in China. No. 8 seed Kamil Majchrzak of Poland also advanced, earning a 6-3, 6-4 victory over Mattia Bellucci of Italy in a tidy 1 hour, 20 minutes. Winners also included No. 6 Fabian Marozsan of Hungary, 6-4, 6-2 over Alex Bolt of Australia, and No. 7 Jaime Faria of Portugal, 3-6, 7-6 (9), 6-4 over Terence Atmane of France. Faria saved two match points in the marathon second-set tiebreaker. Other players to advance included Coleman Wong of Hong Kong, Yunchaokete Bu of China, Taro Daniel of Japan, Hugo Gaston of France, Rinky Hijikata of Australia and Roman Safiullin of Russia. Chengdu Open No. 5 seed Hubert Hurkacz of Poland and No. 7 seed Denis Shapovalov of Canada each survived second-set tiebreakers to advance in the first round in China. Hurkacz had 15 aces and did not face a break point in a 6-3, 7-6 (10) victory over Aleksandr Schevchenko of Kazakhstan, while Shapovalov saved three of four break points to earn a 6-4, 7-6 (3) victory over Tallon Griekspoor of the Netherlands. Other first-round winners included Juan Manuel Cerundolo of Argentina, Nikoloz Basilashvili of Georgia, Martin Damm of the United States, Lloyd Harris of South Africa, Italians Federico Cina and Lorenzo Sonego and Frenchmen Adrian Mannarino and Alexandre Muller. --Field Level Media

item.title: US government seeks to join Elon Musk in challenge against EU's fine on X
item.description: The US government said on Thursday it had formally sought to join a legal challenge filed by billionaire Elon Musk to dismiss a fine of €120 million ($136.51 million) by the European Union against his social media platform X.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: The US government said on Thursday it had formally sought to join a legal challenge filed by billionaire Elon Musk to dismiss a fine of €120 million ($136.51 million) by the European Union against his social media platform X. EU tech regulators [USN:L1N3XB0BG TEXT:"fined"] X late last year for breaching online content rules, the first sanction under a landmark legislation that has drawn criticism from Washington. The US Department of Justice said it had filed an application with the EU's General Court in support of X's effort to annul the case. The EU sanction against X followed a two-year-long investigation under the bloc's Digital Services Act (DSA), which requires online platforms to do more to tackle illegal and harmful content. "The European Commission inappropriately attempted to expand its regulatory authority to reach American companies not present or operating within its jurisdiction," Assistant Attorney General Brett Shumate of the US Justice Department's civil division said. Europe's crackdown on Big Tech to ensure smaller rivals can compete and consumers have more choice has been criticised by the administration of US President Donald Trump , which alleges it singles out American companies. The European Commission, the EU's executive, has said its laws do not target any nationality and that it is merely defending its digital and democratic standards, which it says serve as the benchmark for the rest of the world. Musk, who has financially backed candidates from Trump's Republican Party in elections and supported Trump himself in the last election, has said the EU's tech regulations stall technological progress. Since Musk's purchase of X, then known as Twitter, in 2022, rights advocates and experts have been widely critical of the platform over what they say is increased hate speech, misinformation and nonconsensual sexually explicit content. ($1 = 0.8790 euros)

item.title: Francia enviará tropas para proteger a Arabia Saudita en la ruta del mar Rojo, anuncia Macron
item.description: Francia enviará tropas y sistemas de defensa a Arabia Saudita para ayudar a proteger la ciudad portuaria de Yanbu, en el mar Rojo, que es clave para el transporte de energía, dijo este jueves el presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Francia enviará tropas y sistemas de defensa a Arabia Saudita para ayudar a proteger la ciudad portuaria de Yanbu, en el mar Rojo, que es clave para el transporte de energía, dijo este jueves el presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron. Macron también señaló que una prohibición estadounidense de las exportaciones de diésel —que la Casa Blanca ha negado que se esté considerando— sería "catastrófica", tanto para el mundo como para la economía estadounidense. Macron hizo estas declaraciones en una amplia entrevista televisiva en horario de máxima audiencia sobre la situación internacional, en la que también advirtió de posibles ataques rusos en territorio francés. Ante la creciente presión interna por los altos precios de la energía, Macron trató de tranquilizar a los franceses asegurándoles que Francia disponía de suministros suficientes de gas y petróleo para el invierno, y que trabajaba para garantizar que no se interrumpan los flujos. Los precios del crudo se han disparado recientemente, ya que la principal ruta alternativa para las exportaciones de petróleo saudita a través de Yanbu ha sido objeto de ataques con misiles por parte de los hutíes de Yemen, respaldados por Irán. "Vamos a enviar recursos militares, es decir, soldados, sistemas de radar y sistemas de defensa, para proteger esta instalación. No para involucrarnos en ningún conflicto, sino para proteger esta instalación", dijo Macron a las cadenas TF1 y France 2.

item.title: Argentina economic activity dips 1.4% in July,
item.description: Argentina's economic activity fell 1.4% in July compared with the same month a year earlier, data from the country's official national statistics agency showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Argentina's economic activity fell 1.4% in July compared with the same month a year earlier, data from the country's official national statistics agency showed on Thursday. The decrease for Latin America's third-largest economy was below the 1.8% growth projected by analysts polled by Reuters and slumped from the 2.7% rise recorded in June. Of the 15 sectors tracked by the EMAE, eight different sectors recorded year-on-year declines, led by wholesale, retail trade and repairs, which fell 5.1% compared to the same period last year, and manufacturing, which saw a 4.6% year-on-year drop. The remaining seven sectors posted gains in July, according to the government statistics agency INDEC, led by the fishing sector, which saw a 425.5% year-on-year jump, and mining and quarrying, which rose 8.4%. Javier Milei's government, which faces a presidential election in 2027, has sharply cut public spending to curb inflation, while seeking to revive growth in the industrial, consumer and construction sectors.

item.title: Anthropic signs $11.6 billion cloud deal with Akamai, gets warrant for up to 5% stake
item.description: Anthropic has committed to spending $11.6 billion on cloud services from Akamai Technologies over seven years, while securing an option to take an up to 5% stake in the company.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic has committed to spending $11.6 billion on cloud services from Akamai Technologies (AKAM.O) over seven years, while securing an option to take an up to 5% stake in the company. The seven-year contract could expand by an additional $9 billion, bringing the potential total commitment to about $20 billion. Akamai shares jumped 16% in extended trading on Thursday. The deal is expected to require about $5.5 billion in total capital expenditure. Akamai plans to increase its 2026 capital spending by about $1.7 billion to secure and pre-purchase components needed to support the agreement, including memory. As part of the deal, Akamai issued Anthropic a warrant that could give the AI company a stake of up to 5% in Akamai. About 2% is tied to Anthropic's initial $11.6 billion commitment, while the remaining 3% would vest if the companies expand the agreement by up to another $9 billion. The warrant is equivalent to about 7.7 million Akamai shares and has an exercise price of $111.33 per share.

item.title: Operações voltam ao normal no porto de Santos após incêndio em equipamento
item.description: As operações no terminal da Neves & Marinheiro, no porto de Santos, foram retomadas após incêndio nesta quinta-feira em um equipamento que transportava trigo, informou a autoridade portuária.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As operações no terminal da Neves & Marinheiro, no porto de Santos, foram retomadas após incêndio nesta quinta-feira em um equipamento que transportava trigo, informou a autoridade portuária. Conforme nota da agência marítima Cargonave, equipes do terminal e de combate a incêndio agiram imediatamente para controlar a situação. O terminal da Neves & Marinheiro fica ao lado de operações da chinesa Cofco, que não foram atingidas, segundo a companhia. A Cofco disse, por meio de sua assessoria de imprensa, que as operações de carregamento no porto seguiram normalmente. Não foi possível falar imediatamente com a Neves & Marinheiro, após várias tentativas pelo telefone.

item.title: Ibovespa fecha em queda pressionado por Treasuries e receio fiscal
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quinta-feira, perdendo o patamar dos 184 mil pontos, com o apetite a risco minado por novo avanço nos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos, além de receios com o cenário fiscal no Brasil.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quinta-feira, perdendo o patamar dos 184 mil pontos, com o apetite a risco minado por novo avanço nos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos, além de receios com o cenário fiscal no Brasil. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) caiu 0,99%, a 183.965,91 pontos. Na mínima do dia, chegou a 183.834,97 pontos. Na máxima, subiu a 186.211,43 pontos. O volume financeiro somou R$26,89 bilhões. No exterior, o rendimento do Treasury de 10 anos marcava 5,2209% no final da tarde, de 5,114% na véspera, com preocupações renovadas sobre a inflação e potenciais novos aumentos de juros pelo Federal Reserve. De acordo com a estrategista de ações Rebecca Nossig, da Nomad, o movimento nos juros de longo prazo nos EUA atrai o capital global para a segurança da renda fixa norte-americana, drenando a liquidez e o apetite por ativos de risco em mercados emergentes como o Brasil. Isso, acrescentou, explica a "intensa pressão vendedora sobre a bolsa local e o movimento de realização de lucros". O petróleo referendou os receios sobre a inflação, com o barril sob o contrato Brent fechando o dia com elevação de 3,41%, a US$106,60, diante da ausência de sinais de progressos diplomáticos efetivos nas negociações entre os EUA e o Irã. Em Nova York, o índice acionário S&P 500 (.SPX) encerrou quase estável a sessão, que teve ainda como pano de fundo o aguardado encontro entre o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, e seu par chinês, Xi Jinping. Trump afirmou que ele e Xi tiveram uma “ótima reunião”. O analista de renda variável Felipe Cima, da Manchester Investimentos, também destacou como componente negativo o relatório de avaliação fiscal do governo, que indica um gasto acima do esperado e dificuldade maior de conversão das contas, com frustração de receitas. No documento, o governo informou que [USN:L1N45G0HA TEXT:"reduziu"] de R$17,9 bilhões para R$16,1 bilhões a necessidade prevista de contenção total de verbas de ministérios para respeitar regras fiscais, mas apontou significativa piora na previsão de déficit fiscal em 2026. Cima também chamou a atenção para a possível retirada da receita com as bets, além da expectativa de que a sexta-feira possa trazer alguma novidade sobre programa bancado pelo Tesouro Nacional referente ao endividamento das famílias. O mercado fechou com investidores na expectativa de nova pesquisa eleitoral Datafolha nesta quinta-feira. Nos últimos levantamentos, o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) têm mostrado empate técnico em simulações de segundo turno. Na visão do gestor Luis Stuhlberger, da Verde Asset Management, pode ocorrer uma "[USN:L6N45G112 TEXT:"porrada insana"]" na bolsa se Flávio vencer, mas ele não espera um movimento tão negativo se Lula for reeleito, citando múltiplo perto da média dos governos petistas passados e baixa exposição de investidores a ações. Mas, embora considere um alívio uma eventual troca no Planalto, criticando principalmente a política fiscal de Lula, e estime uma euforia de curto prazo no caso de eventual vitória de Flávio, ele citou que o candidato do PL "não tem um projeto de governo". "Acho que o Brasil vai ser aquele negócio: não se encante com excesso de otimismo", afirmou em evento em São Paulo.

item.title: Agentes dos EUA sem autorização atuam “ilegalmente” em solo das Bahamas, diz embaixador
item.description: As Bahamas acusaram agentes de agência federal dos Estados Unidos de combate às drogas (DEA, na sigla em inglês) de atuarem à revelia e ilegalmente em seu território e levantaram a questão junto ao governo Trump na semana passada, disse o embaixador do país nos EUA à Reuters nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: As Bahamas acusaram agentes de agência federal dos Estados Unidos de combate às drogas (DEA, na sigla em inglês) de atuarem à revelia e ilegalmente em seu território e levantaram a questão junto ao governo Trump na semana passada, disse o embaixador do país nos EUA à Reuters nesta quinta-feira. Autoridades das Bahamas apresentaram a reclamação na sexta-feira durante uma reunião em Washington com o Departamento de Justiça dos EUA, disse Wendall Jones, embaixador das Bahamas nos EUA. A queixa ameaça prejudicar a cooperação entre as autoridades policiais dos EUA e das Bahamas, reacendendo questões sobre soberania, enquanto um importante processo judicial norte-americano contra o tráfico de drogas abala a política bahamiana. Investigadores norte-americanos indiciaram mais de meia dúzia de bahamenses nos últimos 18 meses, incluindo membros de alto escalão da polícia e das forças de defesa do país, acusados de participar de uma operação para contrabandear drogas da América do Sul, passando pelas Bahamas, para os Estados Unidos. Jones afirmou que as acusações não foram levadas em consideração na queixa apresentada pelas Bahamas alegando operações ilegais da DEA. “Fizemos uma denúncia geral sobre o comportamento de agentes da DEA agindo à revelia nas Bahamas que atuam sem o consentimento do governo ou da Força Policial Real das Bahamas, e isso é uma questão de direito, uma questão de tratado”, disse Jones em entrevista por telefone. O Departamento de Estado dos EUA, o Departamento de Justiça e a DEA não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentários. O jornal bahamense The Tribune foi o primeiro a noticiar a denúncia. Na reportagem, o embaixador dos EUA nas Bahamas, Herschel Walker, rejeitou a acusação e a classificou como fake news. Aliadas próximas dos EUA e localizadas a apenas 80 quilômetros de Miami, as Bahamas autorizam sete agentes da DEA a operar no país, disse Jones. Jones não forneceu uma estimativa do número de agentes da DEA que se acredita estarem atuando sem autorização do governo das Bahamas, mas disse que isso vem ocorrendo “há muitos anos”, acrescentando que o governo Trump informou às autoridades que investigará o assunto. As Bahamas não são o único país a apresentar objeções semelhantes. Em abril, autoridades mexicanas alegaram que dois agentes norte-americanos que morreram em um acidente de carro naquele mês estavam trabalhando no país sem autorização.

item.title: India's Akasa in talks with Boeing to order 200 737 MAX aircraft, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: India's third-largest airline, Akasa Air, is in talks to order more than 200 Boeing 737 MAX jets, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's third-largest airline, Akasa Air, is in talks to order more than 200 Boeing (BA.N) 737 MAX jets, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter. A decision on the order is expected early next year, with terms likely finalized in the second half of 2027, the report said, adding that the purchase would support Akasa's fleet growth beyond 2032. Akasa Air and Boeing did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment. The report comes as the Mumbai-based budget carrier expands its fleet of Boeing's [USN:L3N3FY1XA TEXT:"fuel-efficient jets"]. The airline, which began operations in 2022, operates 43 Boeing 737 MAX jets and has orders for 226 more aircraft for delivery over the next decade. Akasa is targeting a [USN:L1N42V063 TEXT:"30% capacity"] increase by March 2027 and is weighing participation in the government's emergency credit guarantee scheme, its finance chief said in June.

item.title: Sri Lanka grab dramatic win over England to square series
item.description: Sri Lanka pulled off a dramatic 16-run win over England in the second one-day International at Headingley on Thursday to level the three-match series despite a heroic effort from injured Jos Buttler.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sri Lanka pulled off a dramatic 16-run win over England in the second one-day International at Headingley on Thursday to level the three-match series despite a heroic effort from injured Jos Buttler. England scored 305-9 in reply to Sri Lanka’s 321-6, which included a century from captain Kusal Mendis in a high-scoring clash in which Buttler looked to be taking England to a comfortable triumph before damaging his hamstring. He retired hurt on 67, but as Sri Lanka pulled themselves back into the contest with key wickets, a limping Buttler came back to the crease, with England needing 20 runs off the last two overs. He was, however, only able to add two more runs before being caught at deep mid-wicket, with his dismissal effectively ending home hopes. England had needed only 63 runs off their last 10 overs to seal the series but were pinned back by the Sri Lankan bowlers, who got their side over the line for their first success of the tour after suffering a 3-0 whitewash in the Twenty20 internationals. Sri Lanka skipper Mendis won the toss and elected to bat, leading from the front as he scored 121 and shared a second-wicket partnership of 137 with Kamindu Mendis, who made 54. EXPENSIVE DROP Kusal Mendis was dropped on 17 by Gus Atkinson at fine leg in an expensive slip off Jamie Overton’s bowling and had another life one run short of his century when he was given out caught behind off Overton but reviewed immediately and the TV umpire found there had been no nick. He cover drove the next ball to complete a seventh ODI century. Pavan Rathnayake added 48 off 39 balls before being run out, and Janith Liyanage contributed 32 before becoming Jofra Archer’s only wicket as the England paceman returned expensive figures of 1-65. England’s reply began in impressive fashion. They took advantage of sub-standard Sri Lankan bowling, allowing Tom Banton and Ben Duckett to put together an opening stand of 143 inside the opening 20 overs. But almost out of nowhere, left-arm spinner Dunith Wellalage bowled Duckett (67) and had Banton stumped for 73 off 61 balls, before trapping captain Harry Brook for a single. He finished his 10 overs with figures of 3-49. Buttler turned the tide in England's favour again before his injury, but stretching to complete a run, he looked to suffer a torn muscle. England won the first ODI by 89 runs at Chester-le-Street on Tuesday, and the decider will be at The Oval in London on Sunday.

item.title: WTA roundup: Alexandra Eala stunned in Singapore
item.description: Tatiana Prozorova of Russia completed a come-from-behind upset of No. 3 seed Alexandra Eala of the Philippines in the Round of 16 at the Singapore Tennis Open, winning 4-6, 7-5, 6-3 on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tatiana Prozorova of Russia completed a come-from-behind upset of No. 3 seed Alexandra Eala of the Philippines in the Round of 16 at the Singapore Tennis Open, winning 4-6, 7-5, 6-3 on Thursday. Ranked No. 180 in the world, Prozorova was down 4-2 in the second set before storming back against the rising star, breaking Eala's serve twice along the way. She slipped behind again 3-2 in the third set but broke back the very next game en route to winning the final four games of the match. The three-hour, nine-minute affair marked the first top-20 win in Prozorova's career. Prozorova draws China's Xinyu Wang in the quarterfinals after Wang defeated Taiwan's Joanna Garland 7-5, 6-4. No. 7 seed Maria Sakkari of Greece eased past Japan's Nao Hibino 7-5, 6-1, and will meet Australian Talia Gibson, who was a 7-6 (2), 7-6 (1) winner over Slovakia's Viktoria Morvayova. Korea Open Taylah Preston of Australia knocked out top seed Jelena Ostapenko of Latvia 6-4, 6-1 in 1 hour, 17 minutes to reach the quarterfinals in Seoul. Preston won 26 of her 32 first-service points (81.3%) and saved 7 of 8 break points. Meanwhile, No. 6 seed Anna Bondar of Hungary avoided a similar fate to Ostapenko's and saved one match point before outlasting Armenia's Alina Charaeva 6-4, 6-7 (6), 7-6 (5) in three hours and 15 minutes. No. 2 seed Kimberly Birrell of Australia defeated Yexin Ma of China 7-5, 6-3. No. 4 seed Elena-Gabriela Ruse of Romania brushed off a tough first set and rallied past South Korea's Yeonwoo Ku 2-6, 7-6 (1), 6-1. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、対円で158円後半 ＦＲＢ当局者タカ派発言で追加利上げ観測
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇し、対円では一...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、対円で158円後半　ＦＲＢ当局者タカ派発言で追加利上げ観測 4:53 配信

２００９年１１月撮影　REUTERS/Yuriko Nakao

［ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇し、対円では一時９月２日以来のドル高／円安水準となる１５８．９８円を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者によるタカ派的な発言を受けて追加利上げ観測が強まったことに加え、堅調な米経済成長への期待を背景に米国債利回りの上昇が続いていることでドル買いが進んでいる。

終盤の取引でドル／円は０．３２％高の１５８．８２円。 片山さつき財務相はこの日、７月の日米協調為替介入を支えた基本原則はなお維持されているとの認識を示したものの、先週の日銀利上げを受けても金融引き締めペースの加速につながるとの見方は広がらず、市場心理は引き続き不安定な状態にある。

日銀は１７─１８日の金融政策決定会合で政策金利を１．２５％に引き上げたものの直後に円安が進み、関係筋によると日銀は１８日、為替介入の準備段階とされる「レートチェック」に踏み切っていた。

米国では企業活動の拡大と物価圧力の高まりを示す経済指標を受け、この日も国債利回りが上昇。３０年債利回りは２００４年６月以来、１０年債利回りは約２０年ぶりの高水準を付けた。この日は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアに対するミサイル攻撃を受け原油価格が再び上昇。インフレ懸念の高まりにつながっている。

ＦＲＢは１５─１６日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来３年２カ月ぶりで、ＦＯＭＣに合わせて公表された金利・経済見通しでは年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げ実施が示唆された。

ＦＯＭＣ後、複数のＦＲＢ当局者がインフレ鈍化が進まなければ追加利上げの可能性があるとの認識を表明。この日はフィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁がインフレ率をＦＲＢが目標とする２％に戻すには追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見方を示したほか、クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁はインフレ圧力はなお高く、この状況が長引けばインフレ率を目標水準に押し下げることが難しくなると述べた。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定する確率は６８．６％。１週間前の５５．４％から上昇した。

ＦＸストリート（ニューヨーク）のシニアアナリスト、ジョセフ・トレビサーニ氏は「２年債利回りは２００８年の金融危機以降のレンジ上限にあり、３０年債利回りは２２年ぶりの高水準、１０年債利回りも１９年ぶりの高水準にある。外為市場参加者にとっては、これ以上の説明は必要ないだろう」とし、「ＦＲＢは今回の原油高は供給ショックによるものと理解しており、その影響をある程度見極めようとしている。ＦＲＢは第３・四半期の経済成長見通しに注目している」と述べた。

終盤の取引で主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１５％高の１０１．２８。上昇は４営業日連続で、一時は１０１．３９と、７月２９日以来の高水準を付けた。

ユーロ／ドルは０．０７％安の１．１３７２ドル。一時は１．１３５８ドルに下落し、７月２８日以来の安値を更新した。

ドルはスイスフランに対し０．３４％高の０．８２８スイスフラン。一時は０．８２９６スイスフランに上昇し、２０２５年５月以来の高水準を付けた。スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）はこの日、予想通り政策金利を０％に据え置いた。足元でスイスフランが軟化する中、為替市場への介入は「必要に応じて」行うとし、従来より姿勢を軟化させた。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 158.83/158.88

始値 158.74

高値 159.03

安値 158.61

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1379/1.1382

始値 1.1373

高値 1.1391

安値 1.1360
