item.title: スターバックス、北米で250店閉鎖へ 事業強化策の一環
item.description: [２４日 ロイター] - 米コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックスは２４日、北米で業績が低迷する２５０店を閉鎖することを明...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スターバックス、北米で250店閉鎖へ　事業強化策の一環 2:29 配信

米ワシントン州シアトルで2025年11月撮影。REUTERS/Matt Mills McKnight

[２４日　ロイター] - 米コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックスは２４日、北米で業績が低迷する２５０店を閉鎖することを明らかにした。２０２６年９月期末までに大部分の閉鎖を完了させる予定で、約３億ドルの関連費用を見込む。関連当局に書類を提出した。北米にある約１万８０００店のうち約１％に当たるという。２０２４年に就任したブライアン・ニコル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）による事業強化策の一環。これまでも、創業地である米西部シアトルの旗艦店を含めた北米の不振店の閉鎖に踏み切っている。

世界の直営店・フランチャイズ店の純新規出店数は２６年９月期に約４４０店舗と、従来目標の６００─６５０店舗を下回る見通しだ。ｅＴｏｒｏのグローバル市場ストラテジスト、ラレ・アコナー氏は店舗閉鎖に関して「コストはかかるものの事業再建に向けて理にかなった措置だ」と指摘した。

スターバックスは、米店舗で待ち時間の短縮やメニューの簡素化を通じて人気回復を目指してきた。店舗運営に投資する一方、本社部門の人員削減や一部の地域事務所を閉鎖。直近まで４・四半期連続で既存店売上高が増加していた。ニコル氏は今年４月、すべての所得層で来店客数が増えていると、取り組みへの手応えを示していた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ氏の金利1％論、政権周辺でも異論　物価高批判そらす狙いか コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 9/25(金) 2:29 ロイター

item.title: RedBird Capital to acquire majority stake in Puck at $250 million valuation, memo says
item.description: RedBird Capital Partners has agreed to acquire a majority stake in Puck in a deal valuing the five-year-old newsletter startup at about $250 million, according to a memo seen by Reuters on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: RedBird Capital Partners has agreed to acquire a majority stake in Puck in a deal valuing the five-year-old newsletter startup at about $250 million, according to a memo seen by Reuters on Thursday. Reuters first [USN:L6N44M16K TEXT:"reported last month"] that Puck was in advanced talks for an investment from RedBird. The deal will give Puck additional capital to accelerate growth, including by investing further in Air Mail, hiring more talent, entering new markets, pursuing acquisitions and expanding its intellectual property into new formats and channels. Puck acquired Air Mail, the digital magazine founded by former Vanity Fair editor Graydon Carter, last year. RedBird became an investor in Puck after the acquisition. The latest transaction will not change Puck's editorial independence or its business model, according to the memo. Standard Investments and TPG, which have backed Puck since its inception, will exit the company, while RIT Capital will remain a minority investor, alongside RedBird. Employees with vested stock or options will receive a combination of liquidity and continued ownership in the company. Puck and RedBird have also created a new equity incentive plan, the memo said. The transaction is expected to close in about a month, subject to anticipated regulatory approval. Founded in 2021, Puck has built a subscription-based business around journalists with established followings in media, finance, entertainment, fashion and politics.

item.title: フーシ派、サウジ首都リヤドとヤンブー攻撃と表明 南部ジザン州も標的
item.description:
Mohammed Ghobari Timour Azhari
[２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Mohammed Ghobari　Timour Azhari

[２４日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２４日、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドの「重要目標」と、紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにある国営石油会社サウジアラムコの施設をミサイルと無人機（ドローン）で攻撃したと表明した。

サウジは現時点で首都リヤドに対する攻撃があったか確認していない。

これに先立ちフーシ派の軍報道官は、イエメンと国境を接するサウジ南部ジザン州の軍事施設を攻撃したと表明していた。数十発の弾道ミサイルと無人機を使って攻撃を実施し、ジザン州にある「作戦室、指揮統制センター、武器庫」のほか、ミサイル発射拠点や軍事キャンプを標的にしたという。

サウジからこの件に関する確認は得られていない。

サウジ民間防衛当局は２３日にジザンで潜在的な危険があるとして緊急警報を発出していたが、２４日に警報は出されていない。

サウジ主導の連合はこの日、フーシ派が２４日に発射した弾道ミサイル６発を迎撃し、南部タイフと紅海沿岸のヤンブー地区への攻撃を阻止したと明らかにしていた。

FAST

OEIRAS, Portugal, Sept 24 : Barcelona sporting director Deco slammed the door on a renewed pursuit of striker Julian Alvarez on Thursday after a summer chase that ended in frustration, and, unexpectedly, a new life for Raphinha as a centre forward. Barcelona had spent the close season searching for a number nine after Robert Lewandowski left as a free agent for Major League Soccer, with Inter Milan captain Lautaro Martinez and Atletico Madrid's Alvarez high on their list. But Deco, speaking to reporters at the Portugal Football Summit, said both paths had led nowhere. "The idea has always been to bring in a forward with good movement and the ability to link up with others, and Julian (Alvarez) was one such player," Deco said.

"It hasn't been possible; we made an offer... the club has always said they wouldn't sell him, so we have to look for other solutions." "Julian (Alvarez) is in the past; we have to look ahead, and we're happy. I hope he's doing well too, that he's helping his club," Deco added on whether the club would pursue the Argentine again in the mid-season transfer window. Barcelona president Joan Laporta had spoken publicly about the club's interest in Alvarez in the close season, drawing an angry reaction from Atletico chief Miguel Angel Gil Marin, who accused the Catalan club of dishonesty and said the Argentine would "never, ever" be sold to them. Barcelona eventually signed Gabriel Jesus as a rotational option for Hansi Flick's squad, but the surprise solution has come from within, with captain Raphinha moving from his hybrid attacking midfielder-right wing role into the centre forward position. The Brazil international has exploded there, scoring 14 goals in eight matches, 12 in seven games in LaLiga, moving to the top of the scoring charts ahead of Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe. "We are happy because we discovered a new face of Raphinha," Deco said. "But more important is that he's happy too. "It is different for him, because sometimes he's not in contact with the ball all the time like he used to. He needs to be prepared to attack behind the defenders. "We expected that he could do well, but not at this level." Deco said Lautaro had also been seriously considered, but Barcelona quickly backed away once Inter made clear their captain was not available. "At one point, amongst the strikers we were looking at, Lautaro was one of them," Deco said. "The moment the club told us he wasn't available, we didn't even try or discuss it any further."

Source: Reuters

FAST

PARIS, Sept 24 : Zinedine Zidane spoke of his "immense emotion" as he prepared to take charge of France for the first time in their Nations League opener away to Turkey on Friday. The 54-year-old, who succeeded Didier Deschamps following his predecessor's 14-year reign, begins his tenure with an away fixture in Kocaeli, less than two months after his appointment. "Maybe even more, actually," Zidane said when asked whether his emotions matched those he experienced winning his first France cap 32 years ago. "It was a long time ago, and today I feel an immense emotion at being here in charge of this France team," he told a press conference.

Zidane's appointment has generated considerable excitement in France, where his first week in charge dominated media coverage, and in Turkey, where one journalist even asked him for an autograph during the press conference. The former Real Madrid manager, however, sought to keep the attention on his squad. "It's the next step after Didier's 14 years, it's something new so it's completely normal. But the main protagonists are the players," he said. "I think you just have to accept the way things are done; I'm not looking for that and I'm not here for that. I'm going to try to do the job with my players, to make sure we can win matches – that's what interests me." Midfielder Adrien Rabiot said Zidane tried to "step back as much as possible to let the players express themselves". "He is with us the way he is on the outside," Rabiot added. "We're fully aware of how important he's been for French football. His aura means he takes up a lot of space and people expect a lot from him." Rabiot, named as one of the team's captains along with Kylian Mbappe, Ousmane Dembele and Jules Kounde, noted that "quite a few things have changed" since Zidane replaced Deschamps. "Some players already, different ways of doing things and also different training sessions," the 2022 World Cup runner-up said. "What the coach wants is obviously a fairly attacking style of play. "We'll be very closely watched for how we play because the coach is new and a lot is expected from him," Rabiot added. France face another away match against Belgium on Monday before Zidane's first home game, against Italy next Friday.

item.title: Alta no frete pressiona exportação de minério de ferro do Brasil, diz Inda
item.description: O aumento nos custos com frete está pressionando exportações de minério de ferro do Brasil à Ásia, gerando reflexos em algumas operações no país, afirmou o presidente do Instituto Nacional dos Distribuidores de Aço (Inda), Carlos Loureiro, nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O aumento nos custos com frete está pressionando exportações de minério de ferro do Brasil à Ásia, gerando reflexos em algumas operações no país, afirmou o presidente do Instituto Nacional dos Distribuidores de Aço (Inda), Carlos Loureiro, nesta quinta-feira. "Com o frete a US$40 dólares, a exportação de minério de ferro dá prejuízo", afirmou Loureiro em entrevista a jornalistas sobre o desempenho do setor distribuidor de aço mais cedo. No início do ano, o frete era cerca de 80% menor. "Deve ter um reajuste do preço (do minério) nos próximos meses", previu Loureiro, cuja entidade acompanha regularmente preços de insumo do aço para identificar tendências de preços da liga produzida pelas usinas siderúrgicas. Segundo dados do Inda, o preço do minério de ferro está estacionado por volta de US$100 a tonelada desde junho, enquanto o preço spot do carvão tem avançado desde julho. "Com o problema (da guerra contra o) Irã, várias exportações de minério ficaram com margem negativa tendo que pagar US$40 de frete", disse o presidente do Inda, citando que a Usiminas Mineração (Musa) parou uma de suas minas neste mês. Procurada, a Usiminas não comentou o assunto de imediato. No início do mês, veículos de imprensa locais afirmaram que a Usiminas paralisou parte de suas operações de mineração em Itatiaiuçu, em Minas Gerais.

US and Iran discuss phased deal to reopen Hormuz and end US blockade, sources say

Reuters

24 September, 2026 10:00 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

By Samia Nakhoul, Parisa Hafezi and John Irish Sept 24 (Reuters) – US and Iranian negotiators in New York are exploring a phased path out of war that would involve Tehran reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Washington lifting its economic blockade of Iran, sources close to the talks said.

The strait has become the central bargaining chip in efforts to end the nearly seven-month US-Iran conflict, with Iran seeking relief from the US blockade that is choking its economy and Washington seeking free passage for ships on the global oil supply route now blocked by Tehran.

The talks face a big obstacle as neither side wants to be the first to surrender its leverage, according to comments to Reuters by two Iranian sources, two regional officials and two Western diplomatic sources, but behind Iran’s stance is a recognition of the economic cost of prolonged confrontation.

Show Full Article

A senior Iranian official said the most plausible way to end the impasse would be a phased arrangement, with Iran allowing navigation through Hormuz in return for the US lifting its economic blockade and Tehran potentially gaining access to frozen assets.

“One way forward would be to solve the crisis in stages. The first would be to end the blockade and reopen Hormuz,” he said on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

That would involve US President Donald Trump accepting another temporary fix, after an earlier understanding collapsed in July. So a central challenge facing the negotiators is not just to sketch out a deal but also to ensure any concessions are durable enough for both sides to trust, the sources said.

Trump has said he thinks the US and Iran could reach a deal after midterm elections to Congress on November 3. A senior European official said the Iranians “have a very long list of demands.”

The White House and the US State Department did not immediately respond to requests for comment for this article.

Former US negotiator Dennis Ross said he saw only a 30% chance of an agreement being reached before the vote, but that both sides may have stronger reasons to make a deal before than after the midterms.

“The blockade is what’s really squeezing the Iranians. It’s strangling them,” Ross said.

A deal before the midterms could benefit Trump, as reopening Hormuz could ease tensions in the Gulf, contain oil prices and help bring down politically sensitive US gasoline prices.

Iran’s chances of gaining much-needed economic relief may be greater while Trump still has a greater political incentive to strike a bargain.

After the midterms, Ross said, Trump may face fewer constraints and be more willing to intensify pressure or consider military options.

LEVERAGE AS OBSTACLE?

The leverage that brought Washington and Tehran back to negotiations could also make compromise harder.

Washington controls the pressure that is hurting Tehran most, while Tehran controls access to a critical energy chokepoint. Neither side wants to surrender that leverage without extracting something tangible in return.

This means the midterms may be less a deadline for diplomacy than for preserving the conditions that make the diplomatic efforts possible. If Washington and Tehran cannot turn leverage into a deal before the midterms, the diplomatic window could narrow as the risk of escalation grows.

Even as it seeks a diplomatic off-ramp, Tehran is preparing for the possibility of renewed war with Washington, the Iranian official said, accusing the US of using the economic blockade and threat of force as tools of coercion.

“Our fingers are on the trigger,” said the senior Iranian official. “The Americans know what they need to do but, because of their excessive demands, the chances of diplomacy resolving this are extremely low.”

Regional sources said Tehran was willing to drop a demand for payment of transit fees to use the Strait of Hormuz from the main agreement and put the demand in a side attachment instead, as ending the blockade had become the more urgent priority.

Gulf states have rejected the proposal for payment of transit fees. Any arrangement would be temporary, not a formal abandonment of Iran’s position, the regional sources said.

The US has tightened the economic vice on Iran, layering new sanctions on top of a blockade that has choked off Iran’s oil exports, an important source of hard currency.

This month, it targeted Iran’s remaining commercial airlines and support networks as part of a campaign to sever the economic lifelines sustaining the government and the powerful Revolutionary Guards. Trump warned that Iran’s economy could “rot” unless it reached a deal.

“Iran is not primarily focused on imposing tolls in Hormuz but on preserving its administrative control of the waterway,” he said. “Iran may be willing to defer the toll issue, but they are not going to give up administrative control of the strait.”

At the heart of the diplomacy in New York is a fundamental tension. Washington wants pressure to produce concessions, Tehran wants pressure removed before making them, and the Gulf states want the conflict resolved without allowing the region’s strategic waterways to become enduring bargaining chips.

FEARS OF AN OPEN-ENDED CONFLICT

During a separate meeting with Trump in New York, Gulf leaders sought clarity on Washington’s endgame beyond the midterms, including on whether the US would resume military action if Iran refused to return to negotiations.

They conveyed their collective rejection of any Iranian control of Hormuz, saying freedom of navigation must be restored and that the strategic waterway should not become a tool of coercion against Gulf states, regional sources said.

Yet alongside their warnings over Hormuz, Gulf leaders have pressed hard for de-escalation and a political process, reflecting the region’s determination to stay out of any further conflict between the US and Iran.

“It’s still not clear what Trump’s endgame is, or what the alternative to the pressure campaign would be,” said Ebtessam al-Ketbi, president of the Emirates Policy Center think tank based in Abu Dhabi.

“The Iranians, by contrast, know what they want. They’re reshaping the regional landscape through Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb with a clear objective while Washington has yet to define its roadmap,” she said, referring to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden.

That uncertainty is also shaping Tehran’s calculations. Danny Citrinowicz, a regional analyst and former Israeli military intelligence officer, said the New York talks had not altered the basic positions of either side and that Iran was unlikely to retreat as long as it believed Trump wanted to avoid a wider escalation before the midterms.

“The blockade is hurting them, but rather than softening their position, it is likely to drive them to escalate because they believe that if they soften their position, they are dead,” said Alan Eyre, a former US negotiator on Iran.

A Western official familiar with the talks added: “It is all about opening the Strait of Hormuz. We’re all under pressure domestically and the Iranians know that.”

(Writing by Samia Nakhoul, Editing by Timothy Heritage)

item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター］ - ２４日午前のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が対ドルで下落し、一時９月２日以来の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場・午前＝円が159円近辺に下落、9月2日以来の安値 1:08 配信

2023年3月10日撮影 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

［ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター］ - ２４日午前のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が対ドルで下落し、一時９月２日以来の安値となる１５８．９８円を付けた。

片山さつき財務相は２４日、円安への対処を巡り「先般の（日米両政府による）協調介入以降のプリンシプル（原則）というのは生きている」と述べたが、日銀の利上げ加速への道筋があると投資家を納得させられなかったことから、地合いはなお弱いままだった。

一方、複数の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者のタカ派的な発言や堅調な経済成長への期待を受けて、米追加利上げ観測が強まったことを背景に、ドルは２カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。

ＦＲＢが前週に０．２５％の利上げを実施し、政策金利を３．７５─４．００％に引き上げて以降、複数のＦＲＢ当局者が、インフレが鈍化しなければ追加利上げの可能性があると示唆している。

主要通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１４％高の１０１．２７。一時１０１．３４まで上昇した。

FAST

Sept 24 : Matthew Breetzke scored a superb 112 to guide South Africa to a 67-run victory over Australia in the first one-day international in Durban on Thursday, but the tourists will rue the loss of cheap wickets as they faltered in their chase. South Africa posted 297 for eight in their 50 overs and Australia were well on course after a fast start, until poor shot selection caused their charge to collapse and they finished on 230 all out, losing their last nine wickets for 101 runs. Australia will welcome the likely return of captain Pat Cummins for the second match in the three-game series in Johannesburg on Sunday, but if this series is a fact-finding mission ahead of the 2027 Cricket World Cup in South Africa, Namibia and Zimbabwe, there will be much food for thought.   "I'm pretty disappointed," Australia captain Mitch Marsh said. "South Africa outplayed us. It was a good game of cricket but we fell well short.

"We had our opportunities, I am probably going to sound like a broken record speaking about having partnerships in our batting, but we weren't able to form many tonight." Australia won the toss and decided to bowl, strangling the South African run-rate early on. But when Breetzke came in at number four, he played conventional cricket shots to get his innings started, before he found a willing partner in big-hitting Marco Jansen. Breetzke, who averages over 60 with the bat in his 15 ODIs, scored his 112 from 106 deliveries and Jansen equalled his career best with 75 in 59 deliveries. Australia started their innings in brilliant fashion as Marsh blasted 60 from 36 balls and put on 90 in 9.2 overs for the first wicket with Travis Head (36 from 37 balls). But too many batters threw their wickets away at the top of the order. Jansen’s sensational diving one-handed catch in the outfield to dismiss Matt Renshaw (44) left Australia on 215-7, a position they never recovered from. South African spinners Keshav Maharaj (4-20 in 9.2 overs) and Bjorn Fortuin (2-34 in 8) showed excellent control. "Very satisfied, all round it was a good fight from the batters and bowlers," South Africa captain Temba Bavuma said. "Looking at how both innings started, we were under pressure in the first 10 overs in each, but we managed to get a very competitive score on that wicket."

Source: Reuters

FAST

WASHINGTON, Sept 24 : Bats are critical players in global ecosystems, pollinating plants, dispersing seeds and eating huge numbers of insects. One of only three lineages of flying vertebrates in Earth's history, there are more than 1,500 bat species living today. But their evolutionary history has been a bit of a puzzle for scientists.     The largest combined bat genome and fossil study ever conducted is now bringing some clarity. Its findings indicate that these flying mammals first appeared in Europe about 65 million years ago, in the aftermath of the mass extinction event that doomed the dinosaurs, before spreading around the world, not in North America, Asia or Africa as previously hypothesized.     The researchers assembled the largest collection of high-quality bat genomes to date, covering 103 species representing all 21 recognized families of bats. They integrated this data with an analysis of 44 fossil bats to decipher their evolutionary history and generate a bat family tree.     They also concluded that, like flight, echolocation — the biological sonar system many bats use to navigate in the dark and catch flying prey — evolved near the dawn of bat evolution.

"I think being able to do both, fly and echolocate, opens up the most amazing opportunities to move into new niches — hunting at night when there's less competition and fewer predators, for example. Flight got them into the air. Echolocation let them own the night," said Sonja Vernes, a professor of biology at the University of St Andrews in Scotland and one of the leaders of the study published this week in the journal Nature. "Echolocation allowed bats to become nocturnal, essentially, and not compete with birds or be preyed on by diurnal (day-active) birds," said zoology professor Emma Teeling of University College Dublin, another of the study leaders.      The study pointed to bats first appearing in Europe about a million years after an asteroid struck Earth 66 million years ago, a calamity that enabled mammals to become the dominant land animals. Relatively soon thereafter, bats reached Africa, making those two continents a hub of early bat evolution, according to evolutionary biologist Liliana Davalos of the State University of New York at Stony Brook, another of the study leaders. Antarctica is the lone continent bats never inhabited. They now account for more than a fifth of the world's mammal species.     The oldest-known bat fossils date to approximately 52 million years ago. Genome and anatomical data helped identify the origination date of bats. BIRDS AND PTEROSAURS     Bats are the only mammals to have achieved powered flight, joining the flying reptiles called pterosaurs and birds as the only vertebrates to do so. Birds survived the asteroid, but pterosaurs did not. The pterosaur extinction may have opened ecological niches that a new lineage of flying vertebrates could fill. Bat wings, built differently than those of birds and pterosaurs, are modified forelimbs featuring greatly elongated fingers that support a large skin membrane. What the ancestors of bats looked like remains a mystery. "We don't know for sure but I reckon they looked like tree shrews starting to grow long fingers. This is just a guess as all of the oldest fossils look like modern bats," Teeling said. It also is unclear whether flight or echolocation evolved first. Bats use echolocation by making high-frequency ultrasonic sounds and listening to the returning echoes bouncing off objects to chart their surroundings. This ability can be seen in fossils based on anatomical traits such as an enlarged cochlea and specialized middle ear structures. "Our oldest bat fossils show that they had both flight and echolocation capabilities, which doesn't help answer this question. We need to find the oldest 'pre-bats,' or transition fossils, and see if they had anatomical characteristics indicative of flight or echolocation," Teeling said.     Many bat species show remarkable resistance to disease and live exceptionally long lives for their size. The study lays the groundwork for research into the genetic basis of these traits.     "This work could eventually inform human research into aging, immunity and disease resistance," Teeling said. Bats today come in many shapes and sizes, with differing diets and lifestyles. The largest is the giant golden-crowned flying fox of the Philippines, with a wingspan of 5-1/2 feet (1.7 meters). The smallest is the bumblebee bat of Thailand and Myanmar, with a wingspan of about 5 inches (13 cm). Many bats are insectivores. Others consume fruit, nectar, fish and, infamously in the case of vampire bats, blood. There is an amazing array, including the likes of horseshoe bats, leaf-nosed bats, mouse-tailed bats, trident bats, ghost-faced bats, mustached bats, sucker-footed bats, hammer-headed bats and wrinkle-faced bats. "Bats constantly surprise us. They're one of evolution's greatest experiments," Vernes said.

Source: Reuters

Sept 24 : BNP Paribas will keep some sensitive customer data and critical operations off public cloud infrastructure even after signing a five-year cloud and AI partnership with Google, the French bank said on Thursday. The agreement gives BNP access to Google public-cloud infrastructure and Gemini models as the bank develops AI agents for internal work including corporate credit memos, sales, trading, research and structuring. But the deal does not mark a wholesale move, BNP Group Chief Information Officer Marc Camus told reporters in a call. "The fact that we signed this agreement with Google doesn't mean that we will get rid of our on-premise infrastructure," he said.

Medical information held by its insurance operations was an example of highly confidential data for which BNP avoids public-cloud solutions, he said. BNP plans to keep using open-source models and to maintain its partnership with French AI company Mistral, with the providers used for different applications.  The bank said it sees scope to use Google technology for less sensitive work such as invoice processing and data management.  Google said BNP would retain ownership of its data, which would not be used to train, tune or refine its models. The bank said Google's AI agents would be authenticated, limited to the resources needed for their tasks, and monitored.  BNP and Google declined to disclose the deal's value.

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 24 : Longer-dated US Treasury yields retreated from earlier highs after 30-year yields touched a more-than-20-year peak, though they stayed elevated as nerves over renewed inflation and further central bank rate hikes kept investors on edge. Oil prices rose about 2 per cent on Thursday as US-Iran diplomatic talks showed little sign of progress, while investors also weighed uncertainty over a potential US ban on diesel exports. A sharp selloff on Wednesday left global bond investors wary, pushing benchmark 10-year yields to their largest daily increase since the April 2025 tariff turmoil. The move was driven in part by stronger-than-expected US business activity data, which showed prices paid surged to a nearly four-year high this month. Traders are worried that higher bond yields could derail the equity rally by making borrowing more expensive and drawing investors out of stocks and into bonds. So far, though, financial conditions still appear supportive of a resilient economy and stock market.

“Nothing in the data suggests policy is currently restrictive,” said Antonio Del Favero, head of US rates strategy at Macro Hive. He added that absent a drop of 20 per cent or more in the S&P 500, and an even steeper decline in the Nasdaq Composite, sustained over an extended period, financial conditions are likely to remain loose. The MSCI World Index halved in value the last time the 10-year Treasury yield broke above 5 per cent, shortly before the global financial crisis. A similar slump occurred less than a decade earlier, when a spike to nearly 6.8 per cent helped burst the dotcom bubble. RATE HIKE ODDS CLIMB The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.37 per cent and the S&P 500 dropped 0.23 per cent. The Nasdaq Composite was down 0.51 per cent, after reaching a record high on Tuesday. MSCI's World Index fell 0.37 per cent and the pan-European STOXX 600 index dipped 0.16 per cent. The interest-rate sensitive US 2-year note yield fell 3.31 basis points to 4.862 per cent. The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes fell 0.18 basis points to 5.112 per cent after earlier reaching 5.1497 per cent, the highest since 2007. The 30-year bond yield rose 0.89 basis points to 5.4109 per cent and earlier peaked at 5.4461 per cent, the highest since 2004. Fed funds futures traders are now pricing in 66 per cent odds of a Fed hike next month, up from around 53 per cent before the S&P data was released on Wednesday. "Inflation is high, central bankers are giving hawkish messages, there's competition from the funding needs of the tech sector and there are no reassuring signs on the US debt trajectory," said AXA's Chief Economist Gilles Moec. Attention now turns to investor demand at Thursday's $44 billion auction of 7-year Treasury notes, following weak interest at Wednesday's $70 billion sale of 5-year debt. Separately, the Treasury Department said it will buy back up to $6 billion in 20- to 30-year Treasuries on Thursday, part of a program designed to support market liquidity. Elsewhere, the yield gap between French and German 10-year debt widened to its broadest level since Mario Draghi's 2012 "Whatever it Takes" speech. TRADE TENSIONS US President Donald Trump was set to welcome Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday for a lavish state summit as both leaders sought to project stability despite deep underlying tensions. While analysts expect few if any major breakthroughs, Washington and Beijing may extend their 11-month trade truce. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the two sides had reached a deal on an initial two-month extension, as Trump personally greeted Xi at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland. In the currency market, the euro fell 0.08 per cent against the US dollar to $1.1371, earlier hitting a two-month low. Against the Japanese yen, the dollar strengthened 0.32 per cent to 158.78. Spot gold fell 0.56 per cent to $4,262.89 an ounce. (Reporting Karen Brettell, Marc Jones and Naomi Rovnick; Editing by Louise Heavens, Alexandra Hudson and Aurora Ellis)

Source: Reuters

item.title: 北朝鮮、核実験停止求める声明を拒否 核保有「不可逆」と外相
item.description: [２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２４日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮外務省は２４日、核実験の停止を求める国際的な声明を拒否した。報道官はこの声明を「敵対勢力」による「わが国に対する重大な政治的挑発」と非難した。

オーストラリア、カナダ、フィンランド、ドイツ、日本、オランダで構成する「包括的核実験禁止条約（ＣＴＢＴ）フレンズ」の閣僚会合は、北朝鮮によるいかなる新たな核実験も無責任で容認できないと表明していた。

２２日にニューヨークで開かれたこの会合は、北朝鮮に対し、関連する国連安全保障理事会の全ての決議を完全に順守するよう求めた。

北朝鮮外務省の報道官は、国営メディアの朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）を通じて発表した声明で、同国を責任ある核保有国だと位置付けた。

同じ日にＫＣＮＡが先に伝えた別の声明では、北朝鮮の崔善姫（チェ・ソンヒ）外相が、北朝鮮の核保有国としての地位は不可逆的だと述べた。

崔外相の発言は、今週の国連総会に合わせて米国、韓国、日本が開いた別の会合を受けたものだ。この会合で３カ国は、北朝鮮の完全な非核化に向けた取り組みを再確認していた。

１９９６年に合意されたＣＴＢＴは、核兵器の削減と最終的な廃絶を目標に、世界のいかなる場所での「核兵器の実験的爆発またはその他の核爆発」も禁止している。

item.title: Heavy rains hit Mexico as Hurricane Polo tracks offshore, expected to make landfall on Sunday night
item.description: Heavy surf and rain lashed southwestern Mexico as "extremely powerful" Hurricane Polo crawls northwest offshore the mainland, the US National Hurricane Center (NHC) said in a bulletin on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Paolo Laudani
item.content:encoded: Heavy surf and rain lashed southwestern Mexico as "extremely powerful" Hurricane Polo crawls northwest offshore the mainland, the US National Hurricane Center (NHC) said in a bulletin on Thursday. With maximum sustained winds near 155 miles per hour (250 kph) Polo has been classified last as a Category 4 storm, a notch down from level 5, the highest level on the Saffir-Simpson scale, which it had previously reached. As the NHC keeps adjusting the storm's force, it said it could see some near-term strengthening and is expected to remain a major hurricane for the next few days. AccuWeather, a private forecaster, expected Polo to make landfall late Sunday night into Monday, to lose some steam and to reach a Category 2 hurricane as it tracks across the Baja California peninsula north of Cabo San Lucas, where local authorities have already begun restricting beach access and closing the local harbor. The NHC said that Polo's outer rainbands are spreading onshore and producing heavy rains. Tropical-storm-force winds are likely occurring along the coast of southwestern Mexico, it said. Polo's hurricane-force winds extend outward up to 40 miles (65 km) from the center and tropical-storm-force winds extend outward up to 125 miles (205 km). Additional rainfall totals of 2 inches to 4 inches (50.8 mm to 101.6 mm), with isolated maximum totals up to 6 inches, are expected across across coastal portions of the Mexican states of Michoacan, Colima, northern and southern Jalisco, and Nayarit. "These swells are likely to cause life-threatening surf, rip currents, and coastal flooding," said the NHC. AccuWeather hurricane expert Nicholas Arman said that if the hurricane stays on the expected track, some rain and moisture can be pulled into Texas. “This is textbook[USN:L6N45F0NL TEXT:" El Niño"] impacts where the strong tropical development in the Pacific ultimately pushes moisture into the southwestern US,” he said How much rain and moisture reaches Texas depends on the storm’s ability to cross the Sierra Madre mountains, a major mountain range system which runs northwest–southeast through northwestern and western Mexico, and along the Gulf of California. “The Sierra Madre often act like a cheese grater to an organized system, shredding it apart and preventing any organized tropical feature from staying together,” Arman added. (This story has been corrected to update the wind speed in paragraph 2, and the rainfall amounts and geographic areas in paragraph 7.)

item.title: Monedas amplían sus bajas ante avance del dólar y retornos bonos Tesoro EEUU
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina profundizaron el jueves sus fuertes pérdidas de la sesión previa, en un contexto de otro avance del dólar en los mercados internacionales y de las alzas de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina profundizaron el jueves sus fuertes pérdidas de la sesión previa, en un contexto de otro avance del dólar en los mercados internacionales y de las alzas de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos. * El dólar tocó el jueves máximos de dos meses, impulsado por el alza de los rendimientos de los bonos y el fortalecimiento de las expectativas de nuevos incrementos de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal, tras comentarios de tono restrictivo de autoridades del banco central y datos económicos sólidos. * El presidente de la Reserva Federal de Nueva York, John Williams, dijo el jueves que era razonable pensar que el banco central estadounidense podría verse obligado a subir de nuevo las tasas de interés antes de que termine el año para ayudar a reducir los riesgos de inflación. * En la misma línea, la jefa de la Fed de Filadelfia, Anna Paulson, sostuvo el jueves que podrían ser necesarias nuevas subidas de las tasas de interés para que la inflación vuelva al objetivo del 2%. * Los precios del petróleo, en tanto, subieron alrededor de un 2% el jueves, después de que un ataque con misiles de los hutíes contra Arabia Saudita reavivó el temor a una interrupción del suministro, pero recortaron las ganancias tras conocerse que Estados Unidos e Irán habían debatido la reapertura del estrecho de Ormuz. * Reuters informó de que negociadores estadounidenses e iraníes exploraban una salida gradual del conflicto, la cual implicaría que Teherán reabra el estrecho de Ormuz y Washington levante su bloqueo económico a Irán. * El peso colombiano nuevamente lideró los retrocesos al terminar con caída de un 2,24%, a 3.349,30 unidades por dólar, completando nueves sesiones de pérdidas en las que acumula una depreciación del 8,57%; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) cedió un 0,11% a 2.609,65 puntos. * El peso mexicano bajaba por la tarde un 1,37%, a 17,7539 unidades por dólar, en su tercera sesión seguida de pérdidas, luego de que Banco de México mantuvo estables las tasas de interés. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, mejoraba hacia el cierre un ligero 0,06%, a 64.239,12 puntos. * El banco central de México (Banxico) mantuvo el jueves su tasa de interés referencial en un 6,5%, como esperaba el mercado, y dijo que sus próximas decisiones se guiarán por el proceso desinflacionario, sin seguir mecánicamente los movimientos de la Reserva Federal estadounidense. * El real brasileño cayó un 0,47%, a 5,1931 por dólar la venta, un mínimo desde fines de agosto. El referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) , en tanto, retrocedió un 0,84%, a 184.254 puntos, en medio del alza de los retornos de los bonos y temores fiscales a nivel local. * El peso chileno , cambió de tendencia y subió un 0,33%, a 959,00/959,30 unidades por dólar, rebotando de su nivel más bajo en casi un año que alcanzo al cierre de la víspera. Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) retrocedió un 1,31%, a 11.299,82 puntos. * El peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,23% a 1.520 por dólar, luego de una apertura donde anotó su mínimo récord en 1.525 unidades. El índice bursátil líder S&P Merval (.MERV) cedió un 1%, extendiendo sus bajas de las sesiones previas. * El Gobierno reportó previo al cierre de los mercados que la actividad económica de julio se contrajo un 1,4% interanual en julio ([USN:ZON00GJPU TEXT:"EMAE"]) y la [USN:S0N44F01B TEXT:"pobreza"] saltó al 32,3% durante el primer semestre del año. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreció un 0,68%, a 3,4150/3,4160 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) avanzó un 0,43% a 1.576 puntos.

item.title: 米新築住宅販売、8月は6.4％増の68.4万戸 8カ月ぶり高水準
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２４日発表した８月の新築一戸建て住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新築住宅販売、8月は6.4％増の68.4万戸　8カ月ぶり高水準 9/24 23:59 配信

米ニューヨーク州ロングアイランドで2025年8月撮影。REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton

[ワシントン　２４日　ロイター] - 米商務省が２４日発表した８月の新築一戸建て住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比６．４％増の６８万４０００戸と、２０２５年１２月以来の高水準となった。買い手が値引きなどの販売促進策を利用したことで８カ月ぶりの高水準に急増したものの、中東情勢を背景とした住宅ローン金利の上昇は依然として住宅市場の足かせとなっている。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は６１万５０００戸だった。

前年同月比では２．０％減少した。

７月分は当初発表の６０万７０００戸から６４万３０００戸に上方改定された。

地域別では、中西部が８４．９％増、南部が６．９％増と大きく伸びた一方、北東部は３６．１％、西部は１５．２％、それぞれ減少した。

新築住宅価格の中央値は前年同月比５．８％下落の３９万３７００ドル。８月に販売された住宅の大半は４９万９９９９ドル以下の価格帯だった。

新築住宅在庫は４８万３０００戸と７月から横ばい。うち半分以上は建設中だった。

８月の販売ペースに基づく在庫の消化期間は８．５カ月。７月は９．０カ月だった。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ氏の金利1％論、政権周辺でも異論　物価高批判そらす狙いか アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 最終更新: 9/24(木) 23:59 ロイター

item.title: S&P 500 cierra casi estable mientras inversores se centran en guerra entre EEUU e Irán
item.description: El índice S&P 500 cerró prácticamente sin cambios el jueves, mientras Microsoft perdió terreno y Meta Platforms avanzó, en un contexto en que la incertidumbre sobre Oriente Medio impulsó a los precios del petróleo y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich, Johann Cherian
item.content:encoded: El índice S&P 500 cerró prácticamente sin cambios el jueves, mientras Microsoft perdió terreno y Meta Platforms avanzó, en un contexto en que la incertidumbre sobre Oriente Medio impulsó a los precios del petróleo y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro. * El S&P 500 y el Nasdaq se recuperaron de mínimos de la sesión después de que Reuters informó de que negociadores estadounidenses e iraníes exploraban una salida gradual del conflicto, la cual implicaría que Teherán reabra el estrecho de Ormuz y Washington levante su bloqueo económico a Irán. * Los líderes de Estados Unidos e Irán intercambiaron críticas esta semana en la Asamblea General de la ONU. Los precios del crudo Brent subieron más de un 3%, acercándose a los 107 dólares por barril, después de que un ataque con misiles de los hutíes contra Arabia Saudita reavivó los temores a interrupciones del suministro. * "Esto simplemente refuerza la idea de que actualmente nos enfrentamos a un factor clave que mueve el mercado", dijo Bill Northey, director senior de inversiones de U.S. Bank Wealth Management. "En realidad, todo gira en torno al petróleo, la inflación y su efecto en las tasas de interés, así como la repercusión de dichas tasas en los mercados de capitales". * El presidente de la Reserva Federal de Nueva York, John Williams, dijo el jueves que resulta razonable pensar que el banco central estadounidense podría necesitar subir de nuevo las tasas de interés antes de que finalice el año. * El desempeño de los gigantes de la inteligencia artificial fue mixto: Microsoft (MSFT.O) y Broadcom (AVGO.O) bajaron, mientras que Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) anotó ganancias. * Meta Platforms (META.O) subió un día después de que la compañía de redes sociales presentó un pequeño dispositivo portátil diseñado para utilizarse con su asistente de inteligencia artificial, lanzado recientemente. * Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro subieron. El de la deuda a 30 años alcanzó su máximo desde 2004. Retornos más altos hacen que los bonos del Tesoro, considerados un activo refugio, resulten relativamente más atractivos para los inversores frente a las acciones. * Según datos preliminares, S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 2,20 puntos, o un 0,03%, a 7.703,83 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 1,76 puntos, o un 0,01%, a 26.937,79 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 162,41 puntos, o un 0,32%, a 51.349,18 unidades.

item.title: 米追加利上げ必要になる可能性、インフレ目標回帰へ＝フィラデルフィア連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[２４日 ロイター] - 米フィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁は２４日、高止ま...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米追加利上げ必要になる可能性、インフレ目標回帰へ＝フィラデルフィア連銀総裁 9/24 23:40 配信

米フィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁。ワシントンで４月撮影。REUTERS/Evan Vucci

Michael S. Derby

[２４日 ロイター] - 米フィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁は２４日、高止まりするインフレ率を米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の目標である２％に戻すには、追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見解を示した。

ポールソン氏は同地区連銀で開催されるイベントの講演原稿で、インフレは「依然として高止まりしている」とした上で、「インフレ率を２％に戻すことが最優先課題であり、労働市場へのリスクを慎重に見極めつつ、目標達成につながる政策方針を支持していく」と語った。

また、「今後、状況が私の想定通りに推移すれば、控えめな追加引き締めが正当化される可能性がある」と述べ、インフレを望ましい水準に戻す上で必要になるとの認識を示した。

ポールソン氏はＦＲＢの先週の利上げ決定を支持したとした上で、会合前に「リスクバランスが変化した」ほか、「基調的なインフレの改善がほとんど、あるいは全く見られなかった」と指摘した。

さらに、インフレ押し上げの一因として、テクノロジー分野への旺盛な投資を指摘した。

米経済については「かなり底堅く、勢いを増しつつある兆候を示している」と言及。「関税措置や中東の紛争によるショックにもかかわらず、足元の消費の伸びは堅調であり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の投資拡大が投資全体をけん引しており、労働市場も安定している」との見方を示した。

ポールソン氏は今年の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で投票権を持つ。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：前途開けた中国人民銀行、「バズーカ砲」不要か コラム：3月のマイナス解除、否定しなかった植田総裁会見の本音 コラム：日銀金融政策の「その先」、政策金利が中立化した後の課題とは＝井上哲也氏 コラム：ウォーシュ氏、問われる「有言実行」　市場の信頼回復は道半ば 最終更新: 9/24(木) 23:40 ロイター

item.title: Sesgo descendente predomina en mercados financieros de Argentina
item.description: La plaza financiera argentina mantuvo el jueves su sesgo negativo de prudencia por la firmeza en los niveles del riesgo país y la evidente retracción operativa liderada por fondos institucionales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La plaza financiera argentina mantuvo el jueves su sesgo negativo de prudencia por la firmeza en los niveles del riesgo país y la evidente retracción operativa liderada por fondos institucionales. A los problemas globales por la tensión bélica en Oriente Medio que presiona sobre el petróleo, y esto empuja a la inflación, hay pautas internas en lo [USN:L1N45G0SE TEXT:"económico"] que condicionan a casi un año de las elecciones presidenciales. "Hay una política económica que sigue sin traccionar el nivel de actividad (...) la economía esta prácticamente estancada y hoy con riesgo cierto de entrar en recesión", expresó el economista Hernán Hirsch en una conferencia. Agregó que "hay un aumento del riesgo país propio de nuestro país que se diferencia del resto del mundo", en un contexto donde "se ha comenzado la campaña electoral y como esta economía no tracciona la probabilidad de reelección de (Javier) Milei (...) hay expectativa de cambio de rumbo" con la incertidumbre que esto conlleva. Los argentinos acudirán a las urnas en 2027 para elegir un nuevo Gobierno, carrera en la que el presidente libertario Milei dijo que irá por su reelección, ante una oposición aún dividida y sin un candidato natural posicionado por el momento. El riesgo país de Argentina se situaba en los 571 puntos básicos hacia las 2000 GMT, un nivel similar a cinco meses atrás, junto a activos domésticos volátiles y selectivos. Los negocios bursátiles mediante el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) porteño cedieron un 1% al cierre, luego de arrastrar una baja promedio del 3% en las anteriores cuatro sesiones, y la deuda pública soberana quedó equilibrada en general, contra un derrumbe del 1,8% en las últimas dos rondas hábiles. "Los bonos en dólares extienden su debilidad que dejan al riesgo país ya por encima de las 550 unidades. El foco de las preocupaciones se originaría también en el desafío de enfrentar un programa financiero bajo un contexto externo más desafiante", sostuvo el economista Gustavo Ber. El peso mayorista se depreció un 0,23% a 1.520 por dólar , luego de una apertura donde anotó su mínimo récord en 1.525 unidades. Para evitar presiones cambiarias extras, el banco central (BCRA) anota hasta ahora una suave intervención mediante la compra de apenas 29 millones de dólares en el transcurso de la presente semana, con la adquisición de solo 8 millones este jueves. Entre analistas comienza a haber puntos de coincidencia en la preocupación por algunos indicadores de la macroeconomía, donde avizoran hasta recesión. El Gobierno reportó previo al cierre de los mercados que la actividad económica de julio se replegó el 1,4% ([USN:ZON00GJPU TEXT:"EMAE"]) y la [USN:S0N44F01B TEXT:"pobreza"] saltó al 32,3% durante el primer semestre del año. La firma de tecnología financiera [USN:L1N45G111 TEXT:"Revolut"] recibió la aprobación del BCRA para adquirir el Banco Cetelem a BNP Paribas Personal Finance, en el país austral, informó la compañía a través de un comunicado.

item.title: New York lawsuit says Polymarket's prediction markets are illegal gambling
item.description: New York's attorney general sued Polymarket on Thursday, escalating her battle against prediction markets, an industry that she says violates state laws against illegal gambling.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Stempel
item.content:encoded: New York's attorney general sued Polymarket on Thursday, escalating her battle against prediction markets, an industry that she says violates state laws against illegal gambling. Attorney General Letitia James filed her petition in a state court in Manhattan, two months after bringing a [USN:L6N43X096 TEXT:"similar case"] against rival Kalshi, and five months after filing [USN:L6N41415D TEXT:"similar petitions"] against two other prediction market operators, Coinbase Financial Markets (COIN.O) and Gemini Titan (GEMI.O) . All were accused of operating without obtaining required licenses from the New York State Gaming Commission. They were also accused of encouraging problem gambling, particularly among people under age 21, and endangering people's financial, emotional and physical health. “By running an unlicensed gambling operation, Polymarket has done more than just knowingly violate state law, they have put New Yorkers at risk, especially those underage who are most vulnerable to problem gaming," New York Governor Kathy Hochul said in a statement. New York is seeking civil fines, the forfeiture of illegal gains, and full restitution to customers. Prediction markets are best known for letting people wager through so-called event contracts on the outcomes of sports, though people can also wager on elections and cultural events such as the Oscars. Polymarket expressed disappointment that state officials decided to sue. "We chose to engage with them directly on the substance and address their concerns," Chief Legal Officer Neal Kumar said in a statement. "They preferred the media hit. Any time the (attorney general's) office wants to swing by, our door is open for a conversation about how we protect consumers and offer fair, transparent and legal markets." TRUMP'S SON BACKS POLYMARKET The case against Polymarket is the latest effort by US states to crack down on an industry that has soared in popularity since faring better than pollsters in predicting that Republican Donald Trump would beat Democrat Kamala Harris in the 2024 presidential election. Those states are also at odds with the Trump administration, with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission claiming exclusive authority to regulate prediction markets. Federal appeals courts are [USN:L6N44P0XA TEXT:"divided"] over who should oversee the industry, raising the prospect the US Supreme Court may need to decide. Founded in 2020, Polymarket bills itself as "the world's largest prediction market." It was out of the US market for more than three years, but relaunched last December following a [USN:L4N3UQ190 TEXT:"green light"] three months earlier from the CFTC. Polymarket also gained an [USN:L4N3UI15F TEXT:"investment"] last year from 1789 Capital, a venture capital firm backed by the president's oldest son, Donald Trump Jr. He is a partner there and a Polymarket adviser. New York said the value of Polymarket's business reportedly exceeds $20 billion. James views prediction markets as "quintessentially gambling" because they let people wager on events whose outcomes they don't control, and expect payouts if they win. Thursday's petition included several recent examples at Polymarket, including whether the Los Angeles Dodgers baseball team would defeat the New York Mets on July 24, 2026 by more than 1.5 runs. The Dodgers won, 4-2. New York also objected to Polymarket's letting 18- to 20-year-olds use its platform, despite a minimum age of 21 under state law for mobile sports betting. By allowing gambling without state oversight, Polymarket is "exposing New Yorkers to gambling addiction with few, if any, safeguards," James said in the petition.

item.title: 米中首脳が会談、トランプ氏「米中関係に誇り」 習氏は台湾問題に言及
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt David Brunnstrom
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt　David Brunnstrom

[ワシントン　２４日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２４日、中国の習近平国家主席をホワイトハウスに迎え、首脳会談を行った。習主席のワシントン訪問は１０年超ぶり。トランプ氏は会談後、記者団に対し「素晴らしい会談」だったと述べた。

米中首脳会談は今年２回目。人工知能（ＡＩ）、貿易、台湾、イランとの戦争を巡る問題など多くの懸案を抱える中でも、両首脳は安定した関係を内外に示すことに重点を置いており、今回の会談は象徴的な意味合いが強く、具体的な成果は限られる可能性があるとの見方も出ている。

会談後に中国国営新華社が公表した会談内容によると、習主席は台湾問題に言及。中国の核心的利益に関わる重要課題との認識を示し、米国に対して「台湾独立」に反対する立場を堅持するよう求め、台湾問題を慎重に扱うことを期待していると述べた。このほか中東問題については、米国とイランが戦闘終結とホルムズ海峡の再開を目的とした６月に成立した合意への復帰を支持すると表明した。

ホワイトハウスは現時点で会談内容を公表していない。

習主席は２３日に首都ワシントンに到着。郊外のアンドルーズ空軍基地でトランプ大統領自ら出迎えた。この日は午前に夫人の彭麗媛氏とともにホワイトハウスに到着し、トランプ氏とメラニア夫人の出迎えを受けた。

トランプ大統領は会談に先立ち、習氏との間に「真に素晴らしい友情関係」を築いてきたとし、「米中関係を誇りに思う」と語った。また、５月の自身の訪中以降、両国が貿易分野で大きな進展を遂げたとの認識を示した。

さらに会談で「安全保障、技術、『スーパーインテリジェンス（超知能）』に関する喫緊の課題について協議する」と述べ、「今日これらの分野で下す決定は、今後何十年にもわたり平和と繁栄を促進することになるだろう」と述べた。トランプ氏は２２日に行った国連総会の演説で、人工知能（ＡＩ）について今後は「スーパーインテリジェンス（超知能）」との呼称を用いる考えを示していた。

これに対し習氏は、友好関係の継続、協力の拡大、米中両国民の幸福促進が今回の訪米の目的だとし、「中国と米国の協力で全ての世界的な課題を解決できるわけではないが、両国の協力なしに多くの問題を解決することは難しい」とし、自身とトランプ大統領は互いを尊重し、定期的に意思疎通を図り、外交、貿易、金融、法執行分野での協力を支持していると述べた。

その上で、米中間の競争は「健全なものであるべきだ」とした上で、中国の門戸は開かれており、米企業の投資を歓迎すると表明。「米国においても中国企業が公正に扱われることを望む」と語った。

このほか、違法薬物対策で米国との協力を強化する用意があると表明。ＡＩについては、両国にはＡＩを適切に発展かつ管理する「能力と責任がある」との認識を示した。また、危機管理能力の向上に向け、両国軍が定期的な対話を維持すべきとの考えも示した。

習氏はこのほか、数日中にパンダ２頭が米南部ジョージア州のアトランタ動物園に到着すると明らかにした。また、今後５年間で１０万人の米国の若者を中国に招き、交流や留学の機会を提供する計画を明らかにした。

首脳会談に先立ち、両首脳はホワイトハウスのローズガーデンで行われた軍事式典に臨んだ。式典では上空を航空機が編隊飛行し、ホワイトハウスの大統領執務室の屋上には米国旗とともに中国国旗が掲げられた。

item.title: 米新規失業保険申請件数19.7万件、57年ぶり低水準近辺
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米労働省が２４日発表した９月１９日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請件数19.7万件、57年ぶり低水準近辺 9/24 23:13 配信

米ニューヨーク市マンハッタンで2021年9月撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

[ワシントン　２４日　ロイター] - 米労働省が２４日発表した９月１９日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比１０００件減の１９万７０００件となった。労働市場が堅調さを増していることを示唆した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万１０００件だった。

申請件数は５７年ぶりの低水準近辺にあるが、これはレイバーデー（労働者の日）などの移動祝日を巡る季節調整の難しさが一因とされる。またエコノミストからは、年末に向けて申請件数を押し下げる傾向がある「残存季節性」と呼ばれる要因も指摘されている。

それでも、申請件数の根本的な傾向は、夏場の大半で低迷した後、低水準のレイオフ（一時解雇）を支えに持ち直した労働市場と整合的な内容となっている。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「イランとの戦争が長引くにつれてエネルギー価格が再び上昇しており、経済はいつ需要面でソフトパッチ（一時的な停滞）に陥ってもおかしくない。時間との勝負と言えるかもしれない」と指摘。「しかし９月中旬の時点では、人工知能（ＡＩ）への巨額の設備投資を一因として経済はフル稼働しているようだ」と述べた。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は１７５０件減の２０万２２５０件だった。

９月１２日までの週の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２０００件増の１７１万９０００件と、２０２３年以来の低水準近辺となった。シティグループのエコノミスト、ベロニカ・クラーク氏は「ここ数カ月安定してきた後、継続受給者数が低水準にとどまれば、今後数カ月で失業率が４％に近づく可能性がある」と指摘。「ただ、労働力人口の縮小に伴う失業率の低下が、必ずしも労働市場の再引き締まりを意味するわけではないという点には注意が必要だ」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 アングル：試される米消費の持続力、物価高に政府閉鎖や雇用情勢悪化で 最終更新: 9/25(金) 0:25 ロイター

item.title: ホワイトハウス、ＣＮＮなど3社の立ち入り認める 地裁命令受け
item.description:
Susan Heavey
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - ホワイトハウスは２４日、ＣＮＮ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷ（旧ＭＳＮＢＣ）、ポリティコの取材記者らのホワイトハウス立ち入りを認めたと明らかにした。連邦地裁がトランプ大統領による３社の立ち入り禁止措置について、違憲の可能性が高いとして直ちに立ち入りを回復するよう命じたことを受けた措置となる。
これに先立ち、地裁はトランプ政権に対し、３社の記者証を直ちに返還するよう命じ、当局が１４日間にわたり排除措置を執行することを禁止した。ただ、地裁の差し止め命令後も、３社の記者はホワイトハウスの敷地への立ち入りを拒否され、混乱が数時間続いていた。
地裁による仮処分決定後、ポリティコによると、同社記者の記者証が没収されたほか、ＭＳ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Susan Heavey

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - ホワイトハウスは２４日、ＣＮＮ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷ（旧ＭＳＮＢＣ）、ポリティコの取材記者らのホワイトハウス立ち入りを認めたと明らかにした。連邦地裁がトランプ大統領による３社の立ち入り禁止措置について、違憲の可能性が高いとして直ちに立ち入りを回復するよう命じたことを受けた措置となる。

これに先立ち、地裁はトランプ政権に対し、３社の記者証を直ちに返還するよう命じ、当局が１４日間にわたり排除措置を執行することを禁止した。ただ、地裁の差し止め命令後も、３社の記者はホワイトハウスの敷地への立ち入りを拒否され、混乱が数時間続いていた。

地裁による仮処分決定後、ポリティコによると、同社記者の記者証が没収されたほか、ＭＳ ＮＯＷの記者は、ホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを拒否されたと明らかにしていた。裁判所命令に反する措置なのか、ホワイトハウスの入館システム上の問題によるものなのかは不明としていた。

item.title: IMF review calls for 'fewer but deeper' reforms in design of loan programs
item.description: The International Monetary Fund on Thursday called for targeted refinements to the design and implementation of its loan programs, including a focus on fewer but deeper reforms, to reflect the challenges of a more shock-prone global economy.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund on Thursday called for targeted refinements to the design and implementation of its loan programs, including a focus on fewer but deeper reforms, to reflect the challenges of a more shock-prone global economy. Civil society groups warned that the IMF's recommendations for changing the conditions built into loan programs could leave developing countries facing stiffer austerity measures at a time when they were already saddled with rising public debt, soaring borrowing costs, sharp drops in official development assistance and successive systemic shocks. "The Fund had a chance to show struggling countries that it had changed ... that it would help countries weather crises without exacerbating inequality and hardship," said Nabil Abdo with Oxfam International. "Instead, it chose to double down on a model that has already caused so much damage, taking another step back towards the dark era of structural adjustment." The IMF said the review does recommend more front-loaded and sustained fiscal adjustments, or budget cuts, because they are associated with higher chances of program success. But it stressed that such front-loading should occur only to the extent feasible, along with realistic steps to boost growth and adequate social spending to protect the vulnerable. "The framework, by and large, is fine," said Rishi Goyal, deputy director of the IMF’s strategy, policy and review department. "But because the context is changing, because there are social strains in a number of members, we need to make sure that our reforms are appropriately tailored," he said. "What this means is a clear focus on fewer but deeper reforms." NEW TOOLS NEEDED The IMF's review of program design and conditionality, its third since 2002 guidelines were put in place, assessed the performance of IMF-supported programs from January 2018 to December 2024 — a period that included the US-China trade war during President Donald Trump's first term, the COVID pandemic and Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Oxfam and other groups argued during the review process that insisting on large spending cuts at the start of a program would hurt ordinary people most, resuming the harsh austerity measures that characterized IMF lending in the 1990s. While IMF policies had proven helpful for some countries, they had also hurt public goods like healthcare in others, cutting the money that the poorest people needed, said Eric LeCompte, executive director of the Jubilee USA Network. "We're concerned that these revisions could lead to policies with some countries that impact public services, public workers or social safety nets," he said. "A lot will depend on implementation." The IMF's executive board backed the recommendations, which broadly call for more balanced reforms that rely on both revenue growth and fiscal consolidation, better assessment of risks and greater realism about project financing. The IMF said the goal was to improve implementation and outcomes, not to lower standards. The review comes on the heels of changes in a [USN:P8N41R0DD TEXT:"joint IMF-World Bank debt framework"] for low-income countries, and a forthcoming review of the IMF's process for evaluating countries' economies. Goyal said the review showed the global lender had responded quickly and flexibly to crises during the seven-year period, helping a number of countries restore stability. But not all countries had been able to restore medium-term stability, pointing to the need for changes in program design. Goyal said the IMF was also introducing a medium-term structural reform tool that would identify reforms and then sequence and tailor them to ensure countries could get "more bang for their buck." Other new tools would enhance the ability of IMF teams and staff to correct course if shocks arose, he said. Critics say the IMF has sometimes failed to enforce its own policies, allowing some countries such as Egypt, Pakistan and Argentina to roll from one lending program to another. Martin Muehleisen, a former IMF strategy chief, said he had not seen the review, but the question was whether the IMF had sufficiently insisted on program conditions being met and holding up disbursements if they were not. "The solution does not lie in producing better frameworks. It lies in timely decisions to stop programs if success cannot be assured," said Muehleisen, now with the Atlantic Council.

item.title: 米インフレ高止まり、上振れリスク継続＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[２４日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２４日、インフレ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米インフレ高止まり、上振れリスク継続＝クリーブランド連銀総裁 9/24 22:59 配信

８月２７日撮影　REUTERS/Ann Saphir

Michael S. Derby

[２４日　ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２４日、インフレ圧力はなお高く、この状況が長引くほど、インフレ率を目標水準に押し下げることが難しくなると述べた。

ハマック総裁はクリーブランド地区連銀で開かれた会議の冒頭で「米経済は現在、堅調なペースで成長しており、労働市場も自身が最大雇用と見なす状態に近い。ただ、インフレ率は依然として高止まりしている」と述べた。

その上で「インフレ見通しを巡る不確実性は引き続き非常に高く、リスクは上振れ方向に傾いている」と指摘。「高インフレが長期化するほど、インフレ率を再び低下させるための対応は一段と困難になり、そのコストも大きくなる」と語った。

ハマック総裁は今年の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で投票権を持っている。

item.description: Sept 24 : Alphabet's Google said on Thursday it will launch a prototype satellite next week in its first in-orbit test of Project Suncatcher, a research effort to explore whether space could potentially host large-scale AI computing infrastructure.Companies including SpaceX and Starcloud are pursuing plans to
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Google plans first test of AI chips in space under Project Suncatcher

FILE PHOTO: Google logo is displayed at Google's headquarters in New York City, U.S., July 1, 2026. REUTERS/Aleksandra Michalska/File Photo

FAST

Sept 24 : Alphabet's Google said on Thursday it will launch a prototype satellite next week in its first in-orbit test of Project Suncatcher, a research effort to explore whether space could potentially host large-scale AI computing infrastructure. Companies including SpaceX and Starcloud are pursuing plans to deploy data centers in low Earth orbit, aiming to harness near-continuous sunlight to power energy-intensive AI computing and sidestep terrestrial constraints on electricity supplies. The new mission, scheduled to fly on SpaceX's upcoming Transporter-18 rideshare launch in partnership with satellite company Planet Labs, will assess how Google's AI hardware withstands launch forces, radiation and extreme temperatures in LEO. After the launch, it will send a prototype satellite carrying Google Tensor Processing Units into low Earth orbit to assess if the AI chips can operate reliably in space.

Space radiation can disrupt or degrade electronics, including by causing data errors known as bit flips. Google said it tested its TPUs while running AI workloads in a facility at the University of California, Davis, but that orbital testing was needed to understand how the hardware performs in the real environment. The company will also evaluate its design to cool the power-intensive chips in the vacuum of space, where conventional airflow cooling is impossible, by combining heat pipes with radiators. But experts have said that the concept remains years from being commercially viable given high launch costs, engineering constraints and satellite production bottlenecks. The first Suncatcher mission is designed to gather in-orbit data and identify potential failure points, rather than demonstrate an operational orbital data center, Google said. It aims to launch two satellites in 2027 to test the high-bandwidth laser links needed to connect future computing clusters.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded:
米経常赤字、第2四半期は2460億ドルに拡大　モノの輸入急増 9/24 22:53 配信

米カリフォルニア州のロサンゼルス港で３月撮影。REUTERS/Caroline Brehman

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２４日発表した第２・四半期の経常収支の赤字額は、前期比３３４億ドル（１５．７％）増の２４６０億ドルとなった。財（モノ）の輸入急増を背景に大きく拡大した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト調査では、経常赤字は２５５０億ドルに拡大すると予想されていた。

第１・四半期の赤字額は、従来の推計値２２６８億ドルから２１２６億ドルに下方改定された。

第２・四半期の経常赤字は国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比３．０％で、第１・四半期の２．７％から拡大した。ドルは基軸通貨としての地位を持つため経常赤字自体がドル相場に与える影響はないものの、米国の「双子の赤字」膨張に対する懸念が強まっている。

第２・四半期のモノの輸入は６７４億ドル増の９３１６億ドルに急増。モノの輸出の２７１億ドル増（６４０３億ドル）を大きく上回った。この結果、モノの貿易赤字は４０４億ドル拡大し、２９１３億ドルとなった。貿易は第２・四半期のＧＤＰを１．１４％ポイント押し下げ、３四半期連続でマイナス寄与となった。

第１次所得収支は１１４億ドルの黒字と、前期の１５８億ドルから縮小した。第１次所得の受取額は４１６２億ドルと、前期の３９１５億ドルから増加。支払額は４２７６億ドルと前期の４０７３億ドルから増加した。

純国際投資ポジション（ＮＩＩＰ）はマイナス２２兆４２００億ドルと前期のマイナス２１兆２７００億ドルからやや悪化した。対外資産は４６兆９７００億ドル、対外負債は６９兆３９００億ドルとなった。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ氏の金利1％論、政権周辺でも異論　物価高批判そらす狙いか アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 最終更新: 9/24(木) 22:53 ロイター

item.description: A senior Morgan Stanley banker covering financial sponsors in Asia leaked the deals by accident via an email he sent to clients.

Morgan Stanley Asia deals leaked in missent email attachment

A senior Morgan Stanley banker covering financial sponsors in Asia leaked the deals by accident via an email he sent to clients.

Morgan Stanley logo appears in this illustration taken on Dec 1, 2025. (File photo: Reuters/Dado Ruvic)

HONG KONG: A senior Morgan Stanley banker covering financial sponsors in Asia accidentally leaked their deal pipeline in an email sent to clients, according to six people with knowledge of the matter. The banker attached the financial sponsors group's deal pipeline by mistake in a weekly update email he sent to clients, the people said. "Morgan Stanley takes client confidentiality extremely seriously. We promptly took steps to address this inadvertent sharing of information and we continue to engage with relevant parties," a spokesperson for the Wall Street bank said in an emailed response to Reuters on Thursday (Sep 24). The banker later retracted the email and apologised for the mishap, urging recipients to delete copies of the attachment and refrain from circulating the document, according to a screenshot of the email seen by Reuters.

The list, dated Sep 21, contained about 60 live IPO, M&A and block trade deals across Greater China, South Korea, Southeast Asia, India and the EMEA region. It also included over 50 deals that were categorised as "pitching", and nearly 30 deals categorised as "on hold". All of those deals concern Asian companies. The vast majority of the companies on the list are portfolios of major global and regional private equity and venture capital firms. Bloomberg first reported on the incident late on Wednesday. The list did not contain details of any of the deals, and a lot of them have already been reported, according to some people who received the email.

item.title: Trump asks US Supreme Court to intervene to allow third-country deportations
item.description: President Donald Trump's administration asked the US Supreme Court on Thursday to allow it to continue to deport migrants to countries other than their own without offering them the chance to show the harms they may face — a key tool in his immigration crackdown.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chung, Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump 's administration asked the US Supreme Court on Thursday to allow it to continue to deport migrants to countries other than their own without offering them the chance to show the harms they may face — a key tool in his immigration crackdown. The administration in an emergency filing asked the justices to put on hold Boston-based US District Judge Brian Murphy's ruling that the Department of Homeland Security's policy to remove migrants to so-called third countries is unlawful, while it appeals to the Supreme Court. The dispute escalated quickly after the Boston-based 1st US Circuit Court of Appeals, which upheld Murphy's decision on September 18, put that decision into effect late on Wednesday. More than 25,000 migrants have been deported to 29 countries under the policy implemented last year, according to a tally by human rights groups, with the vast majority going to Mexico. The Supreme Court [USN:S0N3RD089 TEXT:"previously sided"] with the administration, lifting a preliminary order that Murphy issued earlier in the case halting the removals. The policy is one of a number of measures the administration has taken in its pursuit of Trump's goal of mass deportation. The Republican president has enforced a sweeping crackdown on immigration — among his top priorities — since returning to office last year. The administration has carried out third-country deportations to politically unstable South Sudan, which the US State Department urges Americans to avoid due to the risks of crime, kidnapping and armed conflict, as well as [USN:L8N40L0PE TEXT:"Uganda"], [USN:L6N45A0J8 TEXT:"Equatorial Guinea"], [USN:L6N44H0K1 TEXT:"Liberia"], the [USN:L6N42F03C TEXT:"Central African Republic"], and other nations. In its filing on Thursday, the Justice Department told the Supreme Court that the rulings by lower courts disrupt "an essential tool to remove certain aliens, including some of the worst criminal aliens." The Justice Department said the administration already has canceled flights or plans for removals to various countries, and warned of harms to diplomatic arrangements and US foreign policy. "While certain aliens may benefit from stalling their removal, the nation does not," the filing stated. Trina Realmuto, a lawyer for the plaintiffs at the National Immigration Litigation Alliance, said in an interview the fact that the administration opted to take the case to the Supreme Court was not surprising, as "they have repeatedly and publicly stated an intention to do so." Realmuto said the 1st Circuit's order on Wednesday night "makes crystal clear no flights or buses should carry out third-country removals." STEPPING UP DEPORTATIONS The case began in 2025 after the Department of Homeland Security moved to step up deportations of migrants who cannot be returned to any country listed on their deportation orders. Immigrant rights groups filed a class-action lawsuit on behalf of a group of migrants seeking to prevent their removal to such third countries without notice and a chance to assert the harms they could face. The policy provided that migrants could be swiftly removed to third countries that have provided credible diplomatic assurance that they will not persecute or torture the individuals. For countries that have not provided such assurance, deportees would be notified of their destination and US authorities would assess the likelihood of persecution or torture only if the individual raises such fear on their own. In February, Murphy ruled that the policy violates immigration law procedures and due process protections under the US Constitution's Fifth Amendment. Due process generally requires the government to provide notice and an opportunity for a hearing before taking certain adverse actions. The administration has said these deportations are needed to expel migrants who commit crimes and are considered "some of the worst of the worst illegal aliens in this country" because their countries of origin are often unwilling to take them back. But both Murphy and critics of the administration said the policy is also targeting migrants who had been granted legal protection from being sent back to their home countries. The policy has resulted in deportees being unlawfully transferred by third countries back to their home countries, while others have been abused, detained or have disappeared, the plaintiffs said in a court filing. The 1st Circuit upheld most of the judge's ruling on September 18. On Wednesday, at the behest of the plaintiffs, the 1st Circuit dissolved a pause it had placed on Murphy's ruling during the Justice Department's appeal. The 1st Circuit acted after the challengers to the policy reported that the government had planned to fly a group of migrants to several countries in Africa on Thursday. The case has been hotly contested since it began, and included findings by Murphy that the government "repeatedly violated, or attempted to violate" his orders. Murphy in 2025 found that the administration had [USN:L1N3SR0WF TEXT:"violated"] his order requiring additional steps before attempting to send a group of migrants to South Sudan.

item.title: シュナーベルＥＣＢ理事退任へ、ＩＭＦ転出 理事会人事の再編始動
item.description: [フランクフルト ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のシュナーベル専務理事は２４日、国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シュナーベルＥＣＢ理事退任へ、ＩＭＦ転出　理事会人事の再編始動 9/24 21:58 配信

シュナーベルECB理事、6月30日撮影 REUTERS/Pedro Rocha/File Photo

[フランクフルト ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のシュナーベル専務理事は２４日、国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の幹部ポストに就任するため退任すると発表した。ＥＣＢ理事会の大規模な人事再編が始動することになる。

シュナーベル氏は８年の任期満了を１年前倒しし、来年１月３日付で退任する。その後は、ＩＭＦの市場局長に就任する予定で、同ポストは８月３１日に退任したエードリアン氏の後任となる。

ＥＣＢは声明で「理事会はクーリングオフ期間を設けないことを決定した」と説明。「シュナーベル氏はＥＣＢでの残任期間中、ＩＭＦに関連するいかなる事項にも関与しない」と述べた。

シュナーベル氏の退任により、複雑な政治的駆け引きが始まることになる。ＥＣＢのレーン主任エコノミストは２０２７年５月に退任予定であるほか、ラガルド総裁も遅くとも２７年１０月までに退任する見通しだ。

シュナーベル氏の後任人事はより広範な政治的取引の一部となる公算が大きい。ドイツ、スペイン、オランダ、フランスがそれぞれ有力な理事ポストを狙って綱引きを繰り広げているためだ。

制度上はどの国もシュナーベル氏の後任を争えるが、ユーロ圏３大国であるドイツ、フランス、イタリアが事実上、理事会の常任議席を確保している。

ただ、ドイツが単にシュナーベル氏の後任に別のドイツ人候補を充てるだけであれば、ラガルド氏の退任後の総裁ポストを争わないことを意味する。このため、事情に詳しい関係筋は、シュナーベル氏のポストを巡る駆け引きにはＥＣＢの他の２ポストも絡む可能性が高いと指摘している。

スペインは国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）のエルナンデス・デ・コス総支配人を次期ＥＣＢ総裁に指名すべくロビー活動を展開しており、オランダは前中央銀行総裁のクノット氏を推している。ドイツはブンデスバンク（連邦銀行）のナーゲル総裁を総裁候補として検討していたが、最近はその意向が弱まっているとみられ、別のポストを狙う可能性もある。

一方、既にトリシェ氏とラガルド氏の２人のＥＣＢ総裁を輩出してきたフランスは、主任エコノミストのポスト獲得を目指しているという。

The source said that securing pow

FAST

Sept 24 : Oracle issued a "force majeure" notice to a Blue Owl unit, the developer of a large New Mexico data center, citing potential delays in securing power for the project, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday. Shares of Oracle were down 3.3 per cent. The source said that securing power for the site is Oracle's responsibility under the contract. Oracle cannot terminate the lease under any circumstances, the source said, adding that alternative asset manager Blue Owl has about $3 billion in equity in the project, with Oracle responsible for paying the debt costs. Companies typically invoke force majeure to free themselves from contractual obligations when problems arise beyond their control, a move that can raise concerns among lenders and investors.

Rather than exiting as the main tenant, Oracle is attempting to delay payments should the data center dubbed Project Jupiter get derailed and fail to come online in 2028 as planned, according to a report by Bloomberg News, which first reported the development. Oracle did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. "Project Jupiter remains on our planned schedule," the company said earlier in the day. Blue Owl, which owns the data-center developer Stack Infrastructure, said the notice does not change the financial commitments to this multi-year project. During the development stage, Blue Owl earns a 9 per cent yield on its equity, the source said, adding that upon completion of the project, the levered yield is expected to be around 11 per cent. By invoking force majeure, Oracle extends the period during which it pays Blue Owl the lower development-stage rent. Blue Owl will still receive the higher rent for the originally planned duration, but its start will be delayed, according to the source. The 1,400-acre Project Jupiter campus, which secured $18 billion in loans from a consortium of banks, according to media reports, is part of Oracle's broader agreement with OpenAI to provide AI computing capacity. The data center campus has reportedly faced multiple infrastructure setbacks, including delays to a planned natural-gas pipeline and legal challenges over water and air-quality permits. The project is a part of Stargate, an initiative to build AI infrastructure in the US under a $500 billion investment commitment involving OpenAI, SoftBank Group and partners including Oracle. The massive AI infrastructure build-out has faced mounting challenges, as developers race to secure power and other resources while managing the enormous costs of deploying computing capacity for partners such as OpenAI. Growing opposition from the public has made data centers a political flashpoint, with communities around data center projects raising concerns over their impact on local supply of energy, water and other natural resources. Brokerage William Blair said while this news intensifies worries about regulatory and power-related delays affecting AI deployments, it expects minimal short-term impact on Oracle. "Practically, fiscal 2027 should not be affected, since Jupiter contributes no revenue this year."

Source: Reuters

item.title: サウジ、フーシ派のミサイル6発迎撃 紅海の主要港も標的
item.description:
Mohammed Ghobari Timour Azhari
[２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Mohammed Ghobari　Timour Azhari

[２４日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアは、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が２４日に発射した弾道ミサイル６発を迎撃し、南部タイフと紅海沿岸のヤンブー地区への攻撃を阻止した。イエメンでのサウジ主導連合が明らかにした。

広い地域に緊急警報が出されたが、タイフまたはヤンブーで何らかの被害や死傷者が出たかは明らかになっていない。ヤンブーはサウジ産原油の主要な代替輸送ルートだ。攻撃を受けた東西パイプラインの稼働が再開し、同地にあるターミナルからの原油輸出再開の見通しが改善したばかりだった。

民間防衛筋によると、ヨルダン国境に近い北西部タブーク州にも危険が及ぶ可能性がある。今月に入って激化するサウジとフーシ派の対立の中で、同地域が対象となるのは初めて。

連合は攻撃直後の声明で「テロ組織フーシ派によるいかなる激化や違反行為にも、断固として対処する」と表明した。

これより先、サウジの支援を受けるイエメン政府軍は、南部の港湾都市アデンへとつながる重要な補給路に対してフーシ派が夜間に仕掛けた攻撃を撃退した。政府筋が２４日に明らかにした。

「ヘジャト・アル・アブド」として知られる険しく曲がりくねった山岳道路はイエメン政府を支持して戦う部隊にとっての生命線となっている。イエメン第３の都市タイズや、その南・西部の農村地域へ物資を運ぶ上でも極めて重要だ。また、フーシ派支配地域からは民間便が運航されていないため、海外へ渡航しようとする住民にとって唯一のルートとなっている。

フーシ派は、イエメン西海岸沿いの攻勢により紅海の戦略的要衝であるバブ・エル・マンデブ海峡の沿岸に到達して以来、その成果を固めようと、政府軍への圧力を強め続けている。

タイズ－アデン道路の一部を制圧することでフーシ派はタイズ周辺の包囲網を強化し、政府にさらなる打撃を与えることができる。

フーシ派が紅海沿岸を南下する中、ここ数週間はタイズ周辺を含む複数の旧前線で戦闘が再燃している。

item.title: Netanyahu's fleeting visit to New York mirrors strained US ties
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's unusually brief trip to the United States to address the UN stands in stark contrast to his week-long visit last year that included a meeting with President Donald Trump, reflecting rocky times in US-Israeli ties.
item.dc:creator: Emily Rose, Rami Ayyub
item.content:encoded: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's unusually brief trip to the United States [USN:L1N45G05J TEXT:"to address"] the UN stands in stark contrast to his week-long visit last year that included a meeting with President Donald Trump, reflecting rocky times in US-Israeli ties. Netanyahu is expected to be in New York for less than eight hours before returning to Israel, two Israeli officials said. His office said he would meet nine world leaders, five of them from Latin American nations with which Israel has sought to deepen ties as relations with traditional partners in Europe have been strained by the Gaza war and West Bank settlement expansion. But a statement from Netanyahu's office made no mention of meetings with US officials at the annual UN General Assembly. TOUGH ELECTION LOOMING Israel's former ambassador to Washington, Michael Oren, said he could not recall a time when an Israeli prime minister visited the US without meeting the president, describing this as a blow for Netanyahu ahead of Israel's [USN:L8N3TC04M TEXT:"October 27 general election"]. Trump has met Netanyahu eight times during his second term as president. Their [USN:L1N43V139 TEXT:"last encounter"] was in July. "It's a campaign speech. Now it would be much better if that campaign speech were accompanied by a meeting with the president, or another world leader, or at least the secretary of state, but apparently it's not," Oren said. "I don't recall a time when the prime minister came to the United States and didn't meet with the president... So I'm sure that he was disappointed by that." Netanyahu's office said many world leaders requested to meet him "during the visit, but due to a tight schedule and the need to return before the onset of (the Jewish holiday of) Sukkot, the Prime Minister was only able to accommodate some of them". Netanyahu's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Oren's remarks. Opinion polls indicate Netanyahu could lose the election, his security credentials still shaken by the October 7, 2023 attacks by the Palestinian militant group Hamas on Israel, though he cannot be written off. Netanyahu is to meet the presidents of Argentina, Bolivia, Paraguay, Panama, Ethiopia and the vice president of Colombia, and the prime ministers of Greece, Slovenia and Papua New Guinea, his office said. Trump and Netanyahu jointly launched a war on Iran in February, but the allies found themselves [USN:L1N42N0SE TEXT:"at odds"] as Trump sought to extricate the United States from the conflict with key goals unmet. Washington struck an interim deal with Tehran in June that was opposed by Israel before it unravelled a few weeks later. US public backing for Israel has fallen since the Gaza war began, [USN:L1N43T0O8 TEXT:"particularly among Democrats"]. Israel has faced deepening diplomatic isolation since launching its war in Gaza in response to the October 7 attacks. Earlier this month, once-steadfast allies Britain, France and Canada announced sanctions targeting Israeli settlements in the West Bank, which drew [USN:L6N45G09W TEXT:"a muted response"] from Washington.
